review_text: This was one of the most unique experiences I have ever had! The flight from Phoenix to the Canyon was a bit nerve wracking, due to the small aircraft. Since there were only two of us on the tour, it was private which was nice but if you have a fear of flying this would not be for you. Paul, our pilot was awesome and helped us to feel safe based on his experience.  I loved how this tour included both the aerial view and the scenery of the Canyon on the ground. My husband and I were in Arizona for a short time and wanted to make sure to make the most of our trip. This tour really allowed us to see something unique and fit into our travel plans nicely. I would highly recommend this to others if you are looking for a once in a lifetime experience to see the Grand Canyon from above, the views were priceless!

This was a once in a lifetime, amazing, beautiful experience. 

- the flight out of Scottsdale through the river valleys is beautiful.
- you get to see both north and south side of Grand Canyon. It’s as jaw dropping as everyone says!
- the service, staff is wonderful and super knowledgeable and accommodating.
- one note, (and this isn’t their fault), is the flight can get bumpy in a small plane, especially on the return (it gets windier as the day goes on). Our 2 younger children (6,4) both made use of the air sickness bags.

A few tips/feedback items:
- the hummer tour is really nice and interesting, but really loud. Couldn’t hear almost anything the driver was saying while driving.
- the lunch didn’t accommodate for allergies (the bread is multi grain, not sure what nuts and seeds) also no veggie option.
- overall seemed a bit rushed. Would love to stay in one place and just take it all in for like an hour or so, but most stops were like 15-30
Min.

I hate to write a review in the midst of COVID for a small business, but unfortunately due to our experience I’m writing this in hopes that nobody else has the same experience. We booked a PRIVATE Grand Canyon tour. We spoke with someone over the phone on multiple occasions who explained it would be just us with the possibility of one other person (although they explained that wouldn’t be likely). When it came time for our flight, the pilot + others arrived 20 minutes late, not wearing masks and informed us there would a total of 10 of us on the tour. As you can imagine, we were pretty surprised given that wasn’t what we signed up or paid for. The pilot explained something happened with scheduling and to call Lindsey. We did so and she provided pretty awful customer service. In short she explained yes there were gonna be 10 people and if we didn’t want to go we didn’t have to but either way we weren’t getting a refund or rescheduled. 

Throughout the flight NOBODY including the guests or pilot wore a mask. Nobody suggested or asked for this to be done. This is unlawful in the state of Arizona and county of Sedona. Not only is this against the law, but put customers in great risk. I cannot believe they would allow this and be okay with this. 

I am so disappointed in the service. Highly recommend researching other options prior to booking with this company. I am sure there are other much better companies that would provide honest and safe services.

review_title: Misleading, overpriced and poor customer service
review_text:
My wife and I decided to spend Valentine’s Day in Sedona and booked an air tour of the Grand Canyon. I booked it over the phone with Lindsey whom seems to be the manager. She lead us to believe it would be just us on the plane and when we arrived we were grouped with 7 other passengers, many of which thought they were going alone as well.

When we reached out thinking there was confusion we were told they got booked on her day off. Keep in mind this is in the midst of Covid so flying on a plane with 7 strangers who NONE INCLUDING THE PILOT WERE WEARING MASKS is not ideal.

We were told we did not purchase the cancellation insurance which was never presented when I booked over the phone and we could only get 50% refunded.

So we paid $600+ to fly with a group of strangers who did not comply with any covid protocol.

The overall tour is alright although not nearly close to worth of the cost.

Extremely dissatisfied.

Even due to weather, they wont even do a refund or is able to do a voucher for one year. Honestly very upsetting. It was raining really hard and super cloudy and they made no circumstances. Even if it is sprinkling, absolutely no refund.

We booked the 30 minute ride but decided to go on the longer one once there. Worth. Every. Penny!  You fly so close to the Moose Teeth mountain that you feel like you can touch it. Incredible views of Denali and other peaks. I’ve done lots of things over the years and don’t know how this one could be topped.

I had taken a family summer trip for a half hour seaplane with lake landing. The pilot had a terrible and rude attitude and was not willing to provide any conversation. He seemed to be more of the lets get it over with attitude. In addition he also seemed to be a bit racist (we are Indians) and insulting to our family.

 The tour was supposed to provide sighting of wildlife but we did not spot any. The lake landing was an added 65$ per person, but it was overcast and the pilot simply landed in a different lake than the conventional one without asking us first. The new lake hardly had any beach and the pilot did not provide us enough support to actually get to the beach from the plane without getting wet. 

In all the experience was very underwhelming with simply a take off and landing sequence. I would recommend trying some other activity since this isn't something you should rather do in Alaska. There are several other services that provide much more exciting experiences for a moderate higher cost.

We found a really nice fishing experiance in Talkeetna.Starting with Molly the office manager to the pilots and guides. All were friendly and accomodating. Yes we did catch many fish. We arrived on a full moon and and a front coming through. These two things combined with the guide's knowledge led to a wonderful fishing trip for my wife and I.The weather was challenging for the pilot,but he was smart and confident and overcome the winds on the lake.The office is located on a picturese Fish Lake just outside of Talkeetna. I would highly recoomend this compant to any interested in a float plane trip out of Talkeetna.

This company does not deliver pleasant experiences.

This company makes guest violently ill and then act aggressively toward the guest in a hostile manner causing the guest to become fearful of their personal safety.

review_title: Great way to see the scale of the Grand Canyon
review_text: Thoroughly enjoyable. Professional and pleasant. Took loads of photos and got great views, was able to properly appreciate the scale of the Grand Canyon

Booked direct, over two months in advance. With only a couple hours to go before our flight they tell us it's cancelled, since not enough people signed up for the time slot. They offered times later in the day but we had so little warning that we were unable to make the last minute schedule change. It took over a week to get a refund with zero communication on their end during the delay. 

We spoke to some Grand Canyon park employees and they said they frequently heard complaints about Grand Canyon Scenic Airlines being flaky and dropping reservations with little warning. Buyer beware.

Each seat had excellent views of the Grand Canyon. Taking the whole scene in by air is maybe the best way to understand the size and majesty of the canyon. The crew was professional, aircraft was top notch (nothing rickety here) and the cost was reasonable compared to other air tours we have done in different parts of the country. Highly recommend this flight experience!

review_title: Paid for a seat on a 30 seater flew in a tin can
review_text: We paid to get a ride on a 30 seater and were taken on the tarmac to a beater silver plane in the back. The plane had clank noises when turning on the runway. The pilot was reading a manual during the flight! It Was absolutely terrifying! If you ever felt nervous about turbulence on a big commerical plane you will contemplate your existence bouncing around in turbulence in a 8 seater, especially over the canyon.

review_title: Great way to admire the majestic canyon
review_text: We had a very short time to explore the Grand Canyon. We decided to take the early flight and were completely satisfied in every respect. Of course the views were absolutely magnificent. The crew was very professional and helpful. Everything worked out like a charm.

review_title: Terrible company cancelled with no notice
review_text: The seaplane company called the night before and cancelled the trip for my son and me. They said they were overbooked but we had booked weeks before. Also i asked why they had left it until the night before to call surely they knew they were overbooked long before. My son and i had only 1 day in Seattle and were extremely disappointed. We are still waiting on our $700 refund from Tripadvisor . This is a terrible way to treat people.

We have flown with several different services to Roche Harbor on San Juan Island
and we prefer Friday Harbor Seaplanes : the team are all very personable, helpful,
accomodative to our needs - its been a great comfort to work with them - from extra time flying over city highlights, to circling whales when they show up on our route, to scheduling times - we appreciate their personal, family approach  Todd

review_title: Fishing Trip 2019 to Barkley Sound Eagle Nook Resort
review_text:
I have been to the same resort 8 years in a row and we have flew into Vancouver then flew in from there to the resort by float plane and we have had issues in the past with planes, times,or just not willing to fly in if the weather/cloud ceilings were low. So I decided to fly from Las Vegas into Seattle and float plane into BC from there. It was the best experience of all my trips, as Shane's staff greeted my party of 10 at the airport with a very nice van for the short ride to the Sea Port. The check in was very easy and the waiting room was decorated very nice with all kinds of memorabilia. The plane ride there was great and only took 1:55 minutes with stopping once in BC to check into customs and continue on to Eagle Nook Resort. The pilot was very good at his job and extremely nice. The return flight was great and it only took 1:15 Minutes to get back to Seattle. Overall I would highly suggest Northwest Seaplanes to all of my friends, customers, and clients for their travel to BC areas for Future fishing trips or sight seeing in Seattle.

Thanks Shane and your staff.

review_title: Seaplane Charter to San Juan Islands
review_text: Part of our family vacation this year was an overnight trip to San Juan Islands, and what better way to get there and back than a seaplane!  This was awesome.  The flight is about 45 minutes and offers the best view in town of downtown Seattle, the Olympics, Mt Baker, and lots of other beautiful areas on the way up and back.  There was an error made in our reservation that had the wrong return date, which we didn't realize until they called us to see why we didn't show up.  Their office worked it out with no hassle to get us on a flight back the next day the way we wanted.  Absolutely worthwhile to travel this way.

I booked a flight with Friday Harbor Seaplanes from San Juan Island to Seattle, I was excited for the adventure & thought a flight on a seaplane would be a fun way to end my trip to the San Juan Islands, it turned out to be 1 of the highlights of my trip! Hope to fly with FHS again 1 day!

review_title: What a great way to travel!
review_text: We spent a weekend on San Juan Islands, and the seaplane ride there was definitely a highlight of the trip! The plane is fantastic, and our pilot Shane was even better. Along with a smooth and scenic flight, he provided commentary on the landmarks and history of the area. Well worthwhile!

review_title: Best way to get to San Juan Islands!
review_text: We traveled to Friday Harbor and back to Seattle with Friday Harbor Seaplanes and they were accommodating and such a pleasure to deal with from start to finish. Before traveling to Friday Harbor, we were arriving at Seatac from the east coast, but our flight was seriously delayed.  When I called Friday Harbor Seaplanes, they were able to easily put us on a later flight out to Friday Harbor and cut our stress level down to zero! The flight to Friday Harbor on the seaplane was so much fun, and we even spotted a pod of whales playing along the way.  Our pilot circled for a few minutes so we could enjoy whale watching and then expertly landed us in Friday Harbor right at the docks.  This was such an easy and fun part of our trip that I wouldn't hesitate to use this company again!
Captain Jack was wonderful as he flew us over the Grand Canyon. The tour had an audio component, which was just informative enough but not overdone. The views were stunning and truly magnificent.

review_title: Gentle flight, lots of glacier information.
review_text: It was beautiful, couldn't see Denali but tried. The pilot was very knowledgeable about glaciers. Some of it was so technical I couldn't follow along but it was really neat. I get motion sickness and I did not feel unwell on the flight.  It was about 1.5 hours from wheels up to wheels down.

review_title: Put this on your bucket list
review_text: This was the once-in-a-lifetime trip for my wife and son to see Mt. McKinley/Denali and we had an AWESOME time.  The pilot, Pat A., had over 17,000 flight hours and made sure we were well aware of what to expect and what maneuvers were ahead.  He was also well-read in the geology of Denali Park and the glacial formations.  The weather was clear and calm (one day out of 366) and we were able to get close to the mountain face.  To top it off, K2 gave me a NICE military discount.  Thanks for an unforgettable experience!

The flight was great and seeing the glaciers from the sky was beautiful.  My husband loved the experience in the small 1965 plane and my teens took tons of photos!  Our pilot was great and very informative.  The only drawback for us was the weather didn’t cooperate, so no peak sighting or glacier landing, but no one can control Mother Nature.

My family of 5 ranging in ages of 18 to 73 embarked on this amazing flight in March 2022.  I admit I was a bit nervous as flying can bring anxiety sometimes but Billy - our pilot was GREAT!  He informed us about the flying experience before we headed outside to the plane.  Once outside by the plane, we had additional instructions and it made us all feel quite secure.  We were given headphones so Billy could talk to us, ask us questions, and let us know what we were seeing as we flew overhead.  
We were blessed with a cloudless and BEAUTIFUL day.  Seeing Denali up close was breathtaking.  The time went by so quickly and we are grateful we had the opportunity to experience these mountains upclose and see the glaciers from above.  
we highly recommend this tour.

My daughter and I had a great experience with our flight with Chad. He made sure that we are very comfortable during the flight, views that we saw from the plane were amazing and exceeded our expectations on every level.  We were hoping for a landing on glacier, but due to the weather conditions it was not possible. Despite this our flight was very memorable and we would definitely recommend K2 Aviation.

review_title: One of the highlights of my 2-week trip
review_text: I was able to squeeze in a quick tour at the end of a two-week trip after my flight home was delayed a day, and I'm glad that it worked out - this tour was one of the highlights of my trip. Flying over and around the mountains was an almost surreal experience, even after having spent 8 days backpacking through the wilderness just north of the same mountains. My pilot and guide Chris was knowledgeable, accommodating, skilled, and very friendly - his steady piloting and narration throughout the trip added to an already amazing trip. I can't recommend this highly enough - I'll remember my flight for the rest of my life and am already looking forward to a future opportunity to re-live it.

review_title: The red planes look amazing in photos!
review_text:
There are a few things that set this trip apart for us;
1.) Our pilot, Chris, gave us one of the smoothest flights I have ever been on (sorry Delta).  I wasn't necessarily expecting a bumpy ride but I also never expected it to be so flawless.  The take-off and landing were almost effortless.  I also appreciated the narration by Chris.
2.) You guys, the red plane looks absolutely stunning in every photo we took.  It's only August and I might as well start making the Holiday cards.  If you are torn between two companies, choose the one with the red planes as the color will simply pop in every picture you have.  And if you are really thinking ahead, throw some Santa hats into your luggage and stage the perfect Christmas photo right there in Alaska.
3.)  Do the glacier landing.  I struggled to bite the bullet on this with our family of 5 but after a week in Alaska and lots of spendy excursions, this is the one I truly don't regret. Worth every single dollar.  We did the most basic flight but added the glacier landing and it was everything we could've dreamed.

Enjoy this amazing part of the world.

Wow...hard to explain such a mind blowing experience. I am not a person with a lack of things to say, but this trip left me speechless.  The feeling of being so close to these majestic mountains that were so far away from our hotel is amazing.  Your mouth will hurt from smiling so much. Our pilot EO, was so fun and knowledgeable too. He answered all of our questions and even pointed out base camp so we could get a feel for how high we truly were.  WELL worth it....I can't wait to do it again!

I am rewriting this review, as my first review was softly forced.  The pilot stopped the golf cart near the hangars and asked us to click the links and do the review on the spot…and then he checked our phones to see that the reviews were completed with a thank you screen showing.  While I understand they need reviews as a small business, soft forcing and checking doesn’t feel like it’s the right way to do it.  I’ve been on other plane tours around a couple of the other Hawaiian Islands, so I have reference points for comparison.

Pros:  We did a custom tour, which is supposed to be a combination of two tours, with circumnavigation of Maui and a tour of the surrounding islands.  The views of Molokai and the surrounding area were fantastic.  The pilot, Eric, was skillful and we felt safe.  He was a nice guy and tried his best to be a good guide.

Cons:  (1) I feel like the price of our combined tour was a bit high (around 1250 for two people) especially considering the total time was only about 1.7 hours, which is about the time of just one tour.  I feel like more time could have been spent around west Maui , Molokai/Lanai and Molokini rather than Hanna, which is comparatively not that impressive.  I would not recommend our tour to others, based on my experience and at this price point.  (2)  They could use newer planes.  The current single engine plane (Piper Archer) is very old.  The exterior looks old and the interior is in rough shape.  Again, it was safe, but the plane could at least use a new coat of paint, the seats need to be re-upholstered and the interior needs a good cleaning/vacuuming and wipe down.  Also, the control pod of my headphones was coming apart with interior wires showing, and all the headphones had earmuff covers that were dirty and almost coming off…they could use disposable ear muff covers and mouthpiece covers…these things are very cheaply available on Amazon.  Finally, the pilot’s clothes looked like they were not washed for weeks.  Again, I think the pilot is a nice guy and I have nothing against him, but both my wife and I noticed this and thought it was strange.  Cleanliness is very important…it’s the first things people notice and experience.  These are simple things to fix.  (3) They really need a shared office or at least a hangar where customers can sit down and wait and get checked in etc.  It seems all they have is a parking spot on the tarmac and a golf cart that they use to get customers directly from their cars.  This is ok, but this is just a tip based on what I’ve seen with other tour operators.  

I would recommend this company over a helicopter tour because it is better for a small group.  However, I would like to see some of the things I mentioned to change.  They have been in business for 7 years.  So I feel like some of these things should be addressed for their benefit and that of future customers.  All they have to do is go experience some other airplane tours on other islands (like Kauai for example) to get more tips on how to improve.

Such an amazing experience! Can’t recommend this enough, you will see the island like no other! My boyfriend and I went together, he’s 6’8 and we were a little nervous about his size,  but he fit perfectly and we had the best time! If you have any reservations about this experience don’t, book immediately! Also Eric was the best overall and his landing and knowledge was impressive!

This is definitely a “must do” excursion while in Maui. From start to end, Laura (our pilot) made our sunset flight an unforgettable experience. The views and the spectacular colors of the sunset truly need to be experienced from the air. Highly recommend!

The tour guide Eric was not only friendly, knowledgeable, and patient, but also a skillful pilot. With his incredible skill, we were able to witness the sea cliff from an impeccable perspective. With his patience, we were given multiple chances to take pictures, haha. Great experience, worth spending time with the ones you love.

review_text: Trip was amazing Eric was wonderful positively wonderful take this trip. We love this this is a must do on your trip to Hawaii you say everything.
The flight was interactive, as if we were flying the plane, Eric informed us on history, geography, and cultural importance on the island.

Booked the day before going, very last minute. Everything worked perfectly- from start to finish. Relaxing, beautiful, and breathtaking views that you can’t see without a plane! Liked hearing about the islands too. Pilot loves his job

review_title: Float Plane and hike to visit bears salmon feeding
review_text: This was the best part of our Alaskan cruise. The float plane trip was exceptional,  but the walk through the woods and viewing the bears from a platform was the most thrilling experience.  Our guide Mark knew about the local wildlife and forest plants and trees. Mark had extensive knowledge of bear behavior. I felt safe the entire trip. Only small groups are allowed to visit. Mark made sure we all were able to see the bears; pointing out bears in the woods, creek and waterfall. The trip was magical.

review_title: Nice fligth but limited things to see
review_text: We took Taquan Air at the back end of an excursion to George Inlet Lodge. It was only a 20 minute flight and they flew, most likely, what they had been contracted with for our crab tour. The flight was nice but fairly uneventful. Saw water, trees, more water, more trees, a water fall and shore line. Not much for narration from pilot and actually flew a loop so we saw some things twice - thrill. If we ever used their float plane again we would look at longer flight to see more things like we did the day before in Juneau.

review_title: Beautiful way to see the fjords.
review_text: Pilot not very talkative but the view was spectacular. Would recommend if you want to see the beauty of Alaska.

We booked our round trip flight online and the people were great to work with very helpful and answered all questions repeatedly. We flew on a scheduled flight to Edna Bay Alaska and had the trip coordinated with the arrival of our flight in the morning so we did not have to sit around or spend the night in Ketchikan. I called when our flight was approaching the gate at the airport to let them know we had arrived and that they could come and pick us up from the dock below the airport. We got down to the dock immediately after getting off the plane and standing on the dock. I called again to let them know we were now on the dock and they said a boat would come pick us up. Their business is on the opposite side of the river from the airport.  We waited saw several Taquan float planes take off. I had to call again to let them know we where at the dock waiting and finally a boat came to pick us up. We we got to the desk and told them who we were we found out the plane that we were supposed to be on that was being held for us to get on after we had arrived had already left. There would be another flight in 2 hours. No one came to talk to use and explain why the plane had left, you could overhear a lady in the back state she had screwed up made a mistake. They were sorry but that was it. We waited and finally got on a Beaver float plane. The trip was pleasant. We flew out of our location two weeks later on an otter float plane. They had information about the plane printed up and it was interesting to find out about the history of the plane we were flying on. We made two stops before arriving in Ketchikan so we did get to see some sights.

review_title: Worst service, will not recommend since they discriminate
review_text: We were very much looking forward to this tour when we booked it from Holland America. When we took the tour, 3 other groups left at the same time. We were group of 5 and was only given 5 minutes once the seaplane docked at Misty Fjords whereas the rest of the groups got 15 minutes. When we asked the front desk of Taquan air why we were not given 15 minutes they did not have any answer and they told us that it was up to the pilot. If it was up to the pilot I am not sure why we were discriminated when we paid the same price. If I could give 0 stars I would. Avoid this tour operator, they will not treat you right and you wont get value for your money.

review_title: Anan Creek Bear Viewing Tour our of Ketchikan - Excellent Flight, Outstanding Guide
review_text:
Last year, Taquan (pilot Dave and guide Mark Phillips) did an excellent job at getting us to Anan Creek.  However, due to our ship's limited time in port last year, along with poor tidal conditions, we were not able to actually get to the trail head and take our tour.  This year, we again booked our Anan Creek tour with Taquan and we were not disappointed.  From the bus drive to their terminal, to their check-in and flight briefing process, to the flight itself, and to the tour guide - Taquan offers a safe, informative and exciting tour.

The checkin and safety briefing process was thorough, yet efficient (quick).  We met with our pilot, Eric, immediately after the safety briefing, and he walked us down the pier to our plane.  Eric got us situated on the plane, and then our tour guide arrived.  To our pleasant surprise, our guide from last year - Mark Phillips - was again our guide this year!  Within a few minutes we were skimming across the water and taking off from Ketchikan.  Eric provided some commentary on various landmarks while we were en route to Anan Creek, and Eric's 45 minute flight from Ketchikan to Anan Creek was smooth and comfortable.  At one point as we got near Anan Creek, we encountered a rain squall, and Mark and Eric communicated and made some adjustments which ultimately allowed us to safely land at the Anan Creek landing site.

For any tourists taking a float plane to Anan Creek, it is important to be aware that at low tide there can be significant logistics regarding where/how you get to the Anan Creek trailhead.  When we arrived at Anan Creek, it was low tide - and Eric brought the plane to a small dock that was far enough off shore to avoid grounding the plane.  Taquan had arranged a small boat to transport us from the dock to the shore, and that worked out very well.

If you remember any tip from this review, it is this:  if you want to avoid the potential hassles and delays of low-tide arrivals at Anan Creek by float plane, make sure ahead of time that your pilot knows to putter into the entrance of the creek where the water is deep enough (even at low tide) for any float plane to drop off passengers just below the ranger briefing station.  It is not worth your time, or the risk of grounding, to make land anywhere near the docks or the hut.

Let me say here that our guide, Mark Phillips, was awesome.  Mark was friendly, knowledgeable, and he has the experience of having flown out to Anan Creek multiple times in the past.  Mark was able to provide direct in-flight guidance to our pilot when weather conditions got a bit hairy.  And Mark takes safety seriously:  we were in bear country, and after we made land then Mark unpacked and holstered a weapon and bear spray - which made us feel safe on our hike. 

After we got on land, and after Mark made the preparations for our hike to the bear viewing area, we met with the ranger at the base of the trail and listened to a briefing.  We then set out on the approximately two-thirds of a mile hike up to the bear viewing area.  As we got underway, Mark guided us in the proper way to group ourselves in case we encountered a bear on the trail.  And Mark also provided expert commentary on plants and wildlife that we encountered on the hike.  When we arrived at the bear viewing area, Mark helped us get signed up quickly so that we could get a slot in the bear viewing blind, and Mark continued to provide awesome commentary about different bears and occurrences that we saw when we were up at the viewing platform.  I can't say enough great things about Mark; we highly recommend him if you can get him for your tour.

Taquan runs a great airline, they employ an enthusiastic and knowledgeable staff (including expert guides), and our safety was their priority from start to finish.  Taquan ultimately provided us with a fantastic and memorable tour, and we highly recommend them for anyone looking to take a flight/float plane tour out of Ketchikan.

Trip Advisor review

Our family group of 5 decided to take the Floatplane bear watching shore excursion.   It was a bit pricey but we expected it because you’re flying in a floatplane Believe me when I say we all agreed it was definitely worth the money. 

They picked us up where the cruise ships dock and took us where the floatplanes were. We were given our instructions and loaded on the plane. Our pilot was JR and he was wonderful and knowledgeable. The takeoffs and landings and even the flight itself were all smooth, actually smoother than we thought they’d be. We flew for 30-40 minutes and landed. We were met by our guide and we walked an easy trail for 10-15 minutes and arrived at a platform high up and next to a stream. Besides the mother bear and her cub that we walked by on the trail, there were at least 15 bears catching salmon. Oh and a bald eagle too.  The time we spent there was unbelievable watching the bears in the water fishing salmon out of the stream and some even fighting over their catches. Could have stayed there for hours as it was so fascinating. They allowed us 1-1 1/2 hrs before we headed back. Once again our pilot JR treated us well with a nice flight back. We were then taken back to the cruise ship. 

We all agreed if we ever come back to Ketchikan we are definitely doing this again. No doubt!

Last week we did the seaplane tour of the Misty Fjords on Taquan Air Tours.  The views were spectacular.  However, breathing in diesel fumes while in-flight was not fun.  Anyway, after landing in the water in the fjords, we were allowed to get out of the plane onto one of its floats without life vests.  According to the pilot, the dark waters were about 300 feet deep.  Once we got out, the pilot asked us to scoot on over as much as possible to the front of the plane's float.  However, once you go past the pilot's cabin, there is nothing to hold onto and the float gets narrower.  Following the pilot's request, my teenage daughter, who was second in line from the front, decided to pass the girl in front of her who was holding on to the last piece of equipment on the front part of the fuselage.  So now my daughter, who is not a very good swimmer, ended up balancing herself without holding onto anything near the front of the float.  I asked her to get back so she could hold onto something as what she was doing was dangerous.  She said no because she was following the pilots instructions and practically could not get back because the float by now was packed with most of the 10 passengers and the pilot.  After about 5 minutes of standing on the front edge of the float where it is much narrower, I noticed her losing and then regaining her balance for a bit.  If she had fallen in the water, with her parka and heavy clothing, she would have definitely gone under.  I immediately yelled at her to get back in the plane which she did.  When we got back on land, apparently someone had already told the Taquan staff of this incident.  And when I brought it up with them, the answer I got was that the pilot will be given a talk about this. 

What surprises me is how can something like this get past the safety inspectors?  As a minimum, during all the pre-flight safety briefings, Taquan Air should address the safety of passengers while they are out of the plane on the float over deep dark waters and provide its passengers with life vests.  They also need to make sure passengers are not exposed to high levels of diesel fumes while in flight.

I had done a flightseeing tour in Anchorage that was the highlight of my cruise ship trip to Alaska, that when we stopped in Ketchikan I wanted to do a seaplane tour as well.  This activity has been highly rated by so many reviewers, I decided to do it with Taquan Air Tours.  It is impressive to see their facility as they appear to be running a very successful tour company,  I was disappointed to find out that the 2 hour tour, was not 2 hours flying, but rather 2 hours from the start of the shuttle at the port to return to the port.  Our flight ended up being an hour and five minutes.  I never saw the waterfall they said we would see.  The pilot did not allow us out of the plane when we landed stating it was too slippery.  Others taking the flight that day did so.  Our pilot didn't point out very much.  Misty Fjords was pretty much just forest and to make this flight even less enjoyable they were playing Credence Clearwater Revival music over the headphones!!!  Seriously?!?!?!  That is music from my era, but not what I want to hear when I am supposed to be viewing beautiful scenery.  I advise you to skip this expensive excursion.  Not worth it!
Our pilot Mike was an excellent tour guide giving great detail behind the outstanding visual scenery.  The fjords are just unbelievably beautiful.

We got of our cruise ship early and were able to purchase our trip from one of the operators at the end of the dock.  Apparently they sell what the cruise lines have been unable to sell, so are able to sell unsold seats at a discount.  It’s a risk but if you are flexible this is a great option.  We were placed on an early tour and a shuttle took us to the Taquan office.  After a safety briefing we met our pilot and boarded our sea plane.  From here it was a magnificent early morning flight to a floating pontoon in the Tongrass National Forest.  Words cannot do justice to the scenery and the tranquility felt during our short stay on the pontoon.  Time on plane and short stop was about 90 min.  Our pilot Forest was extremely professional and provided a great commentary.  Definitely one of the highlights of our Alaska trip.

Really great flight with views of humpback one way and mountains the other. Ex navy pilot so in good hands. The bear watching was a short 10 min walk through the rain forest with Mark out guide. He was very handy when we met a mother and cubs on the path both times! The bear viewing was excellent on a raised platform overlooking the salmon run and falls. We saw 3-6 bears over an hour and they were catching the salmon below us. Great tour and informative and friendly guide who was handy for close to encounters of the bear kind!

review_title: Wind up that Bush Beaver and Let's Rip
review_text: We dealt directly wit Taquan Air by email to book this rather than through our ship. Much cheaper and really easy to do, they are really easy to deal with directly and are happy to answer your email questions. They came picked us up and took us out to their base about ten minutes away where we got a short safety briefing and then we were off -Misty Fjords here we come. Apparently this company only do window seats except me, the solid one on the plane got to sit in the primo co pilot seat and was assigned the job of lowering the landing gear for landing! (pilot was kidding  - you land on water skis). They kind of look at you and tell you where to sit in the plane based on your size but everyone had a primo seat - that way the plane flies flat and straight, they say. We lucked in with a cracker of a day so we got emerald green fjords under an electric blue sky. We took off on Ketchican Harbour down the side of our ship before heading across mountains that are awesomely beautiful. I was having such an awesome time i have no idea how long we flew before we landed on a deep blue lake high in the mountains. A whole lake to ourselves with no other tourists. Absolute wilderness, absolute bliss. We stayed for about 20 minutes before taking off again and headed across more lakes and massive mountains for ages before heading back and landing on Ketchican Harbour. The trip was awesome, our pilot was awesome, the commentary was awesome, the service was awesome and I love the t-shirt i brought. Try and book in the morning as they look like they get busy later in the day. Thanks it was awesome and on top of that they drop you back to the boat for free!

The flight itself is really scenic. I liked that we landed in the water about halfway through and could walk out on the sides of the plane to take in the view. Pilot was good but didn't talk much. I figured he might talk about the sights, etc. but he was very quiet. They had a recording that they played but even with the headphones at full volume, you could barely hear it.

We went through the Carnival cruise excursion and even though it says no bags/purses, they've got lockers for your stuff and you can bring a small purse with you. When you first get off the bus, be sure to go right in and sit down for the safety video and hold off on going to the restroom until after because they like to be efficient. They then split you up into smaller groups for the plane and sit you by weight but everyone gets a window.

Flight was also chilly, not that I expected it to be heated but there was a gap along the door that let in a ridiculous amount of cold air so be sure to bundle up.

Taquan Air Tours was the perfect place to book a Misty Fjords flightseeing trip. Where other than Alaska can you take the opportunity to tour via a float plane. The views were spectacular and takeoff and landing on the water was an experience not to be missed. I posted a few pictures as words can describe the experience. Also worth noting was office crew –they were incredibly organized from booking to drop off and even scheduled van pick up from my cruise ship.

If you have never experienced flying in an authentic, historic float plane (sea plane) then you should not miss this trip out to the misty fjords. Flying over the enormous Tangass national forest our pilot, Brentwood with 'just' 47 flying years, made us all feel completely at ease as he guided the plane up over snow topped mountains and eventually dropped down and landed on Nooya lake. Whilst sitting on the lake the tranquility left us with a lasting memory of a wonderful experience.

After being in Alaska for about a week, we were really looking forward to our float plane ride - as we had already seen so many fly by.  We had an absolutely perfect day for flying. We took a ride back from George's Inlet to the cruise boat.  Our pilot was grumpy and not personable.  He had the ability to communicate with us via headsets - but only told us a couple things.  I am not sure how long the ride typically is - but he certainly didn't make any detours.  It was a cool experience - but a bit disappointing.  Next time (I hope there is a next time) I am in Alaska, I will definitely take another float ride - but it won't be with Taquan.

review_title: Classic Misty Fjords Flightseeing Taquan Air - Rude Pilot Behavior
review_text: I did this excursion today on 06/20/2013 and I had a bad experience on this ride which I would like to share especially from the pilot of of our float plane.  First of all he tried to accommodate 6 people on the plane and I was asked to sit all the way in the back where there was no cushion for your back.  My back is still hurting.  Taquan air says guaranteed window seats but they do not tell you that their back seats do not have cushions on it.  The reason I did not create a fuss on the spot was because that was the last tour and my ship was leaving in 1 hour and there was no other tour available so us it as an advice and if you book it through Taquan air make sure to ask at the counter that they are not asking you to sit in the back.  I forgot the name of the pilot but he was the oldest pilot in their team and it was my bad luck that I had to fly with him.

review_title: Best excursion we did in Alaska!
review_text: This was one of the best things we did in Alaska on our two week vacation! We did the Denali Flyer with Glacier Landing. Although our original flight was cancelled due to weather we were able to reschedule. It was incredible! The views from the air were stunning and the flight was so smooth. Landing on the glacier was like landing on the moon! It was other-worldly. We loved every minute of this! Would definitely do it again!

My favorite excursion so far in Alaska! Pilot Lou flew a smooth flight and landing on the glacier. I learned so much about how the glaciers, mountains and waterways were formed. He's educated about the geology of the area and shared his knowledge with us, encouraging questions, and made sure both sides of the plane could view what he was describing.
Stepping onto a glacier was unreal! Stunning views, trip of a lifetime! And K2 Aviation even sent a shuttle to pick us up from our campground.
Very cool sweatshirts and tshirts in their gift shop too.

I need to reschedule the flight for 3 times because of Glacier Landing. When I asked a front desk person, when was the last glacier landing, she did not able to answer me which is quite awkward whereas K2 Aviation giving advertisement always with Glacier landing. So I need to choose only Denali Grand tour without Glacier landing which is fine cause they can not land on hard ice or weather contsraints. However, as a Company they should have keep the statistics or records when was the last glacier landing or the ideal time of Glacier landing chances so customer can plan accordingly.

The grand tour was good but it would be nicer if the pilot would narrate the navigation during fly as it was depicted on their website pages how would be the navigation and what mountains and peaks would be covered as well as an handly print out of this navigation so customer can enjoy the total journey fully instead of just seeing white glaciers from the top.

Exceptional flight! Thanks to the pilot Matt extra and so nice...full of explanations 
We keep an unforgettable memory

Big big thanks to Everett at the office, a nice person who is always open to help tourists.
Fantastic flight moment with Devin who proposed us a very safety and magical discovering of the Canyon. We were so confident with him.
Thank you very much to the Maverick team, very happy to share such an experience with a professional team like you.

We went on the Canyon Spirit ride and I'd say it was the best way to see the Grand Canyon. It's hard to imagine another way to so fully appreciate the size of the canyon, and our pilot was able to point out a variety of interesting facts while answering questions throughout. It was also a pretty smooth flight, for anyone concerned about riding a helicopter.

review_title: No experience as trip never materialized.
review_text:
The trip was canceled due to bad weather on 13 Sep. 2022. The Helicopter company told us the refund would be made by the  TRIP ADVISOR.

Yet to receive a refund from TRIP ADVISOR.

Absolutely awesome!!!  My wife and I went back and forth over the cost and then we decided to just do it.  All of us loved it.  Kids had a blast.  The terminal/main building is very nice and it is a comfortable easy place to relax until your ride is ready.  Overall I couldn't recommend it more.  So worth the money.  Beautiful flight and unreal views.  The 45 minutes was just the right amount of time.  If you get motion sick easily, you may find the ride too much, but not people wouldn't be bothered at all.

review_title: Best way to see the canyon!
review_text: This is by far the best way to see the Grand Canyon!  Our pilot Eddie provided a detailed explanation of everything we were viewing and made the flight really enjoyable.  Great perspective for pictures.  Being able to see both the north and south rims as well as multiple views of the river(s) below was incredible.  Highly recommended!

review_title: DO THIS HELICOPTER TOUR!! You won’t regret it.
review_text:
Mavericks did a fantastic job from the time I made our reservation through to the after flight picture taking. They are extremely professional and have a very efficient and accurate system for reservations and disseminating information needed to prepare for the flight. The flight itself is spectacular. Our pilot, Daniel, pointed out interesting geological and historical places as we passed over them. He was an excellent pilot with a very reassuring manner to ease any trepidation first time flyers might have.
I’d give them 10 Stars if that were possible. DO THIS!!! It is so worth the money!!!

review_title: Booked seats they did not have!! So disappointing to completely miss out on this!
review_text: Got a call a couple days before our flight saying we'd booked through a third party and our seats were actually not available.  WRONG.  We booked directly on Mavericks website and paid the retail price exactly so this would not happen, even scheduled at the very beginning of our 2 day trip in case something happened and a reschedule was necessary.  Well, after checking the lady confirmed indeed we had booked directly thru Maverick, but alas SORRY our seats are still were not available  and the only seating option was three days later AFTER we leave.  We set aside this relatively big chunk of money as the big special thing we were doing at the Grand Canyon.  Never got to even experience it.  So disappointing when you travel far from home...
This was well worth the cost! This is a great tour. The helicopter vantage is one that is impressive. The view was breathtaking.

review_title: Amazing Helicopter Flight with Papillon Grand Canyon Helicopter Tours at Tusayan
review_text: We had a good experience. It could have been more informational and valuable if our pilot was more interactive.

The views of the Grand Canyon along the stop offs are spectacular.  We did some hiking into the canyon which was awesome too. But the helicopter ride over the Grand Canyon is overwhelming!  I can empathize with people who say they cried at the first sight of it. The colors are spectacular!  The Little Colorado looked like Caribbean ocean running through the canyon. I highly recommend this tour. My six year old son cannot stop talking about it.

review_title: THE FIRM LACKS INTEGRITY AND FOLLOW UP
review_text: Never book with these people....  I made a reservation for September 30 and they said it was confirmed for Sept 23rd.  They never sent a confirmation, never got one and they called me to confirm on the same day a few minutes before the take off and are not going to change my reservation according to them....  If you have not read the other reviews you should do so, this place lacks follow up - lacks the desentcy of calling up and confirming.  I don t arrive to Las Vegas till Sept 27 --- Thus impossible to make the reservation on the 23rd.  DO NOT BOOK WITH THEM -----  DONT.... there are other better options.

review_title: Surreal -a must item on your bucket list!
review_text: My husband and I did this tour something we’ve wanted to do and are so happy we did it! The helicopter tour out of the Grand Canyon national park airport is the way to go. The views were breathtaking..It was an incredible experience and if you can do this in your life time you should! Our pilot was great and entertaining.

review_title: Just WOW - An Experience Like No Other!
review_text: My family of 4 did this tour last week and were beyond impressed.  We opted for Maverick because of their fleet of newer helicopters with ample windows spanning down to the floor in the front.  Navigation to the airport and check in was so easy, with a relaxing space and gift shop to wait prior to the flight.  We chose the 45 minute flight because I don't know when my next opportunity will arise to take a helicopter tour, and I didn't regret this small upgrade in price.  We saw so much yet 45 minutes passed by quite quickly.  We travelled with our 7 and 10 year old children and were placed in a private tour with no others, which was wonderful and we all had a fantastic view, I was in front with the two kids and my husband was behind the pilot next to the window.  Our pilot Mark was phenomenal; very skilled in flying, knowledgeable on the geography of the Grand Canyon, and entertaining.  At no point were we nervous, even my 7 year old son, it was a very calm and amazing experience.  I was actually more nervous just walking on the trails into the canyon later that day rather than flying high over the canyon itself.  We never would have seen the Colorado River and some of the formations without taking this tour.  The only thing I would have prepped my kids with prior is that we were assigned seats once we got outside to the helicopter (they were happy and luckily we had no issues) and that once we're flying, we had to talk via the headsets.  I could tell my son started getting a little frustrated because he couldn't follow all of the pilot's information pointed out, but I was able to tell him to just relax and enjoy, there is no quiz afterwards, and he was much better after that just soaking in the sights.  You can't see the Grand Canyon like this any other way, it's such a unique experience and was well worth it.  It is an experience my family will remember forever.

review_title: The best way to experience the Canyon
review_text:
Myf irst time in a helicopter. I was nrevous. Our pilot, Quincy, allayed all my fears with his quiet confidence and then very obvious expertise, 
It was a truly wonderful experience, absolutely te best way to experience the Canyon. It all passed too quickly.
I thoroughly recommend it

The Grand Canyon scenery was absolutely spectacular from the ground so we were expecting even better views from the helicopter flight over the Grand Canyon. However, unfortunately we were allocated middle back row seats and the views out of the windows were severely restricted. Those fortunate enough to have been allocated front row seats had unrestricted views. Seat allocation is determined by helicopter weight and balance requirements so you don’t get a choice where you are seated but you pay the same price.
In summary we did not consider back row middle seats were value for money and wished we had not bothered with the Helicopter Flight and spent more time enjoying the spectacular scenery on the ground.

review_title: Amazing flight over Grand Canyon, terrible service from office staff
review_text: Booked weeks in advance qhe wecwere at home on New Zealand. Acidently bookex yhe wrong mouth. Booked August 19 instead of September 19. Was not in US o  August 19. No refund from Maverick and rhus eas a sream trip. I could not disappoint my partner so rebooked and paid full price twice. Not impressed  at all with Maverick and their handling of this situation. Money hungry corporate.

If you are in the front you get a panoramic view of the canyon but in the back you get a panoramic view of the front passengers. Its very unfair that Maverick charge the same price whether you are in the front or the back of this helicopter. Very frustrating when three of the passengers are whooping with joy as they board..... As several reviewers have pointed out, if you are an average male you should expect to be in the rear seat and if you are in the middle dont expect to capture any decent photos. Sorry Maverick, but this is grossly unfair.

If you're thinking of visiting the Grand Canyon this is not to be missed. I'm a nervous flyer so I was a little apprehensive about booking a helicopter flight but there was nothing to worry about. The initial part of the flight is over a woodland between the airport and the south rim, during this part of the flight the helicopter stays quite low to the ground which gives you time to get used to the idea of being in a helicopter before you get to the canyon edge and the once you get to the canyon there is so much to look at there isn't time to be nervous! There was also music on in the helicopter which really helped to calm my nerves. The pilot we had was named BJ and he was very chatty and helpful throughout the flight telling facts about the canyon and answering any questions we had. We took the 45 minute flight from the south rim and it was definitely a once in a lifetime experience, I don't believe there would be any better way of seeing the canyon! 

Just something to remember - Arizona is an hour in front of Nevada!  I know this is probably obvious to most people but being from a country which is all within 1 time zone we didn't think to check and it nearly caused us to miss our flight!
Tour guide was energetic, informative and funny! Got to experience more than just VNP. Great experience! Worth the price.

review_title: Lack of maintenance on planes and terrible customer service
review_text: Terrible experience, don’t recommend. They schedule flights every 30 mins and don’t do maintenance between flights. When we arrived this super young pilot comes out in shorts and flip flops, barely talks to us (his name was Sergio). Once we were up in the air for 5 mins we hear him ask for permission for landing. I asked him why we were going back and he said “something was dirty in the motor but he couldn’t explain it in words I would understand”.  We arrived, he made us get off, and had us call customer service for a refund. Nobody gave us any explanations or apologies. Don’t waste your time here, find yourself a reputable company

I really enjoyed the tour!! it was my mom's birthday gift
the tour was beyond my imagination and very affordable prices.
very nice gift and experience 
The best in the market
Eagles Air Tours are the best.

Never book this tour! The tour didn‘t take place without notice! We stood infront of the company and we couldn’t fly WITHOUT any notice! The person on the phone was super unfriendly and hung up the phone on us.

I booked this trip for my husband's birthday and I couldn't be happier! He loved the whole experience! Check in process was a breeze. Our pilot Sergio was very nice and gave us an amazing tour. We saw Palmetto bay, Coral Gables, South Beach and more! The best time to watch the sunset is 5:30pm-6:30pm. It was an exceptionally beautiful day and we took amazing pictures and videos. I would definitely book another trip in the future. A+

We booked the private tour at 5:30. We got there at 4:45. (Booking says to get there 30 mins earlier.) When you get to the destination they have no office. They just get fuel from the major companies there. (I think) we waited for about 50 minutes. The pilot wasn’t there I think he was home when I called the company at around 5:25 to know what time he was going to be there. But once he got there he took us out pretty quick. Take off was good. Bit scary/ sketchy because the plane is pretty old. But the overall experience was great! The tour was so much fun, the young man was very informative. I enjoyed the time being in the air. (Was probably like 25-30 minutes.)  Would do again! Just hopefully their timing is better.
Fully recommending everyone who want spend time in the sky with love of your life with glass of champagne. Great anniversary gift!

Its really important to note that the weather is a huge constraint on this activity. My boyfriend and I booked the flightseeing tour with glacier landing months in advance with of course no idea the weather. We got extremely lucky being the day of our flightseeing tour, was the only day of our entire trip that had clear skies. The flight was amazing, pilot Phillip was so nice and informative. He even took some amazing photos of us in front of the plane. I get motion sickness pretty easy but this was not an issue for me. Before boarding the flight, I asked if I could sit up front and the pilot said yes saying "its kind of a 'whoever asks first' can sit in the front". The front seat is most definitely the best view but they navigate the plane in a way where everyone gets a chance to see everything. K2 made our experience super relaxing and stress free. We stayed right in Talkeetna so we just simply walked to K2 aviation and essentially walks on the plane.

We enjoyed the beautiful views of the glaciers. Was disappointed that our pilot didn't give us any narration or information about the history and geography of the land and we were unable to ask or communicate with him as mics were not active. He was a good pilot and friendly on the ground. His tour guiding skills had no interaction with the people after takeoff.

review_title: I like over all, but with few exceptions.intolerable gasoline smell inside inside despite wearing mask .
review_text:
Flight pilot didn't give full rules & regulations prior to departure.My wife  got up & switch seats  for better view & to avoid gasoline smell
Then the pilot raised his voice spoke to her very rudely Infront of all passengers.I understand his frustration because of federal aviation rules.but he didn't mention before boarding clearly.He should have mentioned nicely rather rudely.

review_title: Great tour, once in a lifetime awesomness
review_text: We took the flight tour with the mountain landing and it was one of the best vacation experiences we have ever had. The views on the Denali range and the national park were stunning. The crew was very professional and for us this is literally one of the best vacation decisions we have ever made.

Exceptional sights of majestic peaks and valleys.  Weather conditions did not permit viewing of Denali or the glacier landing.  But the sights afforded by the Ruth Glacier were simply incredible.  Must do activity, even if weather does not permit sighting of Denali from up close.

The staff of the company were super nice and helpful.  Our pilot was fantastic -- superb flyer and provided knowledgeable commentary.  The owner is a gem of a person.  We got to know her a little bit when she stepped in to drop us off at our hotel as her staff was incredibly busy (short staffed due to current COVID related issues).

This was the experience of a lifetime. By nature of their business, weather can play a role in their ability to provide their service. K2 was phenomenal at staying in communication with me when inclement conditions threatened our adventure. I am so thankful for the upfront, clear, and continued communication from the staff. Everyone was so professional and kind. Now, my flight tour of Denali was nothing short of amazing. Our pilot, Chris, was full of relevant facts and totally down to earth. It was a pleasure flying with him. Even though the planned flight couldn’t happen due to conditions, we we’re able to take an alternate flight, and Chris made sure it was worth our time and money. Seeing Denali from on top of the clouds was a once in a lifetime opportunity. I hope I get to go back someday, and if I don’t, no regrets. K2 and Chris gave us a phenomenal experience, so good that even my young adult children who are impossible to impress were blown away.

Matt was a great pilot and seemed to know the Otter we were flying in. The weather could have been better but I could still see how massive Denali was close up. It was a great experience and I'd definitely do it again. The hosting center at Tolkeetna airport is spacious, new, comfortable with plenty of bathrooms.

We had a wonderful family flightseeing trip with K2. Much to our and our kids' disappointment, our morning flight was initially cancelled because of smoke from forest fires. But K2 managed to squeeze us in on a flightseeing tour with a glacier landing a few hours later, and it was the highlight of our trip for my teen and tween daughters! Our pilot patiently answered my nine-year-old's questions on the flight and took terrific pictures of us on the glacier. Great trip and great staff!

review_title: The peak of our Alaska trip
review_text: We were lucky in our private flight over Denali to have clear skies, and it was the most incredible experience of our Alaska vacation.  There’s no way to describe it in words.  Our pilot was very communicative and informative.

The entire experience was beyond our wildest expectations.  Stan, the pilot, and the K2 office staff were very kind and helpful.  The flight scenery is hard to convey with words...Spectacular, awesome, breath taking, larger than life are the first words that come to mind and I could go on forever. Landing on a glacier, high up on Denali itself was an unforgettable and immeasurable experience.  I assure you my review does not even come close to capturing the grandeur of the experience!

Best experience of my trip. Daniel was our pilot. He was just as excited as the rest of us. Before we took off, the whole staff was informing us that the clouds were coming in and we might not get to land on the glacier. On the flight up Daniel was telling us what we were seeing and saying he was still hopeful for a landing. Turns out the clouds weren't as bad as they thought and we got to land. He helped us take pictures, pointed out mountains and shared tales. Overall K2 is the only flight company I would trust flying with. Everyone we met seemed to love their job and it makes you feel relaxed seeing that.

Awesome time. Most unbelievable thing you have ever seen. Pilot was awesome and had tons of knowledge about the area. Was a smooth process from start to finish. Will 100% fly with them again next time we are up this way.

The pilot was nice and informative. However, I was bit disappointed because the weather was not that great. However, they showed us video of snow mountains that we would see   just before the flight. We purchased the trip and when we go up we didn't see any snow mountains at all. We saw green mountains of denali national park. This kind of view one can get from regular plan. We spent $200 to see this ? I would have appreciated if canceled the flight or told us upfront that we WON'T see snow mountains. When I talked to the lady there she was not responsive. I am sure they have good trips when whether is nice but there is no need to give us trips that are worth it.

Heads up for people booking with K2.  They are eager to book (W/ Glacier Landing) any one of 4 Denali flightseeing trips.  The problem is when you get there (in our case after a 2 1/2 hour drive from Anchorage) they tell you that the weather won't allow us to do the flight you scheduled but they can fit us on one we didn't schedule and, there will be no Glacier landing.  Upon further inspection we find out the real issue was.   1) our flight was not full and there were miraculously 2 seats left on the flight we were offered.  2) the pilot said it has been "over 2 weeks" since they did a Glacier landing.  I would have rated this a 4 if they would have told us at any point before arrival of the change.  I would have rated a 5 if they would have been truthful about Glacier landing.  Felt like bait and switch.

review_title: really fun - these folks are pros
review_text: Had a wonderful tour with a Glacier landing and highly recommend this to anyone who wants to see Denali as the views from the ground are fleeting.  Captain Chip was skillful and informative, everything about the K 2 operation was top flight - no pun intended,

review_title: Flight  up Denali to glacier landing
review_text: This is the second time I have made the trip..and it's an approxinately 1.50 hour trip of absolute wonder. We landed approx 11,000 ft. I really can't express the sheer joy of seeing the inside of  of the mountain and the many glaciers..not something you can see from the ground. So unless you are an extreme skier or mountaineer this is the best it gets.K2 pilots are fantastic and extremely knowledgeable

We took an afternoon flight over Denali with our pilot Chris. He was so knowledgeable and explained everything about what to expect on our flight. I had total confidence in him and was 100% certain We would have a successful flight. He explained what we were seeing In Detail and answered all our questions. You can't go wrong with K2. Everyone we asked in town recommended them.  I wished the flight could have lasted longer but we only signed up for the 1hr 15 min flight. I would suggest if you can land on the glacier. We will definitely do that next time.

We did this as a spur of the moment thing, and as it was a nice day we are glad that we did. The views and scenery were spectacular and the view to Mt McKinley was amazing. We booked it as a walk up and it was $180 pp. the pilot was fun and friendly and was a decision we are glad we made. Must do.

review_title: Great flight with outstanding pilot Chip.
review_text: My husband and I took the flight with glacier landing.I am afraid to fly but the flight and landings were so smooth. The pilot  CHIP SONN was so friendly and knowledgeable, he really took the whole experience to the next level.

review_title: The only way to see Mt. McKinley
review_text: A really great way to see Mt. McKinley.   We were blessed with clear skies and a great pilot.   Incredible views of one of God's greatest creations.

review_title: Finally gor to see Mt. McKinley!!
review_text: This was my second time flying with K2 Aviantion. Both flights were amazing and totally different experiences. Our trip this year we finally got to see Mt. McKinley and it was breathtaking! Saw a ton of glaciers, some moose, mountians everywhere and a knowledgable pilot! Over all I highly recommend K2 Aviation and look forward to flying with them again on a return visit to Alaksa!

It has always been my dream to take a flight seeing tour with a glacier landing and man-oh-man did K2 deliver!  We had a gorgeous clear day to see Mt McKinley in all its glory.  K2 is a top notch company.  Tour left on time, pilot was great- smooth sailing and smooth landings as well.  My sister was a little bit apprehensive about the flight in such a small plane but she was pleasantly surprised that it was not an issue at all.  Can't wait to go back and have this experience again.

review_title: We never got our flight in but I would recommend them based on safety!!
review_text: We spent two days in Talkeetna hoping to do a flight around Mt. Mckinley and do the glacier landing.  From the time I made reservations (months in advance) I was completely impressed with the professionalism of this company.  Due to weather we were unable to make the flight and although they tried to reschedule us when the weather cleared we were unable to stay in the area another day.  We had a fully packed schedule while visiting multiple cities so our time in Talkeetna was limited.  Those that came off the plane while we were in the building had rave reviews of the flight.  We went through the check in process which was extremely easy and when our flight ended up not going out they refunded our deposit.  I can tell safety is there top concern and that says it all.  If planning a trip to Talkeetna put in enough time to be able to schedule another flight incase you don't get out on the originally scheduled one.

Very enjoyable in an 8-seater plane allowing everyone to have a window seat.  Views of McKinley and the Glacier were amazing.  The pilot did a great job providing information, which made the flight even more interesting.  This is a wonderful company (with shuttle service) to see the glaciers by air.

We were blessed with a clear blue sky and a unlimited viewing of the ice fields and mountains in Denali. The pilot was gracious and accomplished. We had a glacier landing which was smooth and memorable.  The pilot even took pictures of us and did a great job describing the mountains and glaciers we viewed. It was the highlight of a wonderful trip to Alaska and if you can fit in a flight seeing tour by every means, do so. It will never be forgotten.

review_title: Nice views of Mckinley however Rude Pilot
review_text:
In a nutshell, the views of Mckinley were stunning however the pilot, a gentleman from Pennsylvania, exhibited the height of rudeness. And no, I'm not misunderstood. He was blatantly rude. The flight itself was very nice and to his credit, he gave all information about the mountain and surroundings. However he didn't like being interrupted during the flight (hello.... we had booked the flight therefore within reason, we could ask questions if we wanted); He didn't like our kids interrupting him either. Basically he made us very uncomfortable during the flight to the point where we just wanted the flight to be over and done with.  Not sure whether the reason for this was our non-caucasian origin. At the end of the flight, he didn't even have the decency to say goodbye and went about doing his own stuff with the airplane. We could see other pilots escorting their customers right upto the office however our pilot was simply not interested. My wife also observed this behaviour. I will certainly not recommend K2 due to this extremely uncomfortable experience due to the pilot's very obvious rude behaviour. At one point during the flight our 6 year old daughter who was sitting behind the pilot's seat ACCIDENTLY kicked his chair and he gave her a nasty look. We were like "she's a kid for god sake". 

At the end of the trip, my wife and I kept asking ourselves what the reason for his rude behaviour could have been. Unfortunately we couldn't find an answer. We really couldn't have done anything to get him this upset. 

To summarize, Mckinley views were unbvelievable however K2 pilot certainly didn't have any people skills. He needs to be more patient and show more tolerance towards non-caucasian folks.

review_title: A flight that I will never forget
review_text:
We were traveling in Alaska for about 1.5 weeks in September of 2011.  We knew that we would have to be flexible with the weather but we were hopeful things would work out.  At the start of the trip we had to cancel some water events on the coast due to rain and wind.  We had a chance to visit the Denali state park and had a great time on the Tundra Wilderness Tour.  We had not gotten a view of Mt. McKinley but also understood that only 30% of people get to see the mountain so we enjoyed our visit in the park and the animals that got to see.  Heading south to Talkeetna we were amazed to see the clouds clear up and Mount McKinley finally show.  We had a flight schedule with K2 Aviation the next morning but we knew that by then it might be back in the clouds.  We gave K2 Aviation a call and they were very helpful in letting us move our trip time.

They came to pick us up at the hotel and we found that four others were also scheduled for next day and moved their time.  As we now had a total of seven people going they sent us up in a twin prop plane.  The plane was in great shape and comfortable.  We took off and had the just the best flight.  The pilot gave us some great narrative on the mountain and what we were seeing.  The air was so smooth and the plan really quick.  We were at the mountain within 15 minutes and flew around the mountain for at least 35 minutes.  No matter which way you looked it was just amazing.  I consider this one of the best events of the trip.  If you are in the area and the weather breaks you really need to look K2 Aviation up and take a flight with them.  The memories will last a lifetime.

review_title: K2 Aviation: "Wow" Is All We Can Say!
review_text:
All I can say is GO. And K2 is the company to GO with.
That's our experience. And what an experience it was...

If you have the means and the wherewithall to
afford this trip, it is worth every penny and K2
is the company to fly with. The trip is expensive for sure.
but what the heck... You only live once. You'll never have an experience
like this again. Denali at 20,000 feet. It is the grandest adventure beyond your wildest
dreams.

I don't have the luxury of comparing K2 Aviation with other
flight comapnies in the area.

But I can share with you, this IS the trip of a liftetime,
an incredible memory that you will always remember.

We selected the two hour Denali Grand Tour, and believe me, it was
worth it.

The K2 Staff is incredibly relaxed, courteous, and well organized.
They are certainly willing to spend time with you via email, over the phone,
or in person answering all your questions and addressing your concerns.
They are a great crew.

We traveled with them on Wednesday June 8, at 1PM. Tony was our pilot.
There were a lot of people flying that day at different times.

The weather in Alaska is tricky and constantly changing. The weather on Denali
even more so, as the mountain makes it's own weather. The pilots and the company itself, are very attuned to the constantly changing weather conditions. If in doubt, they simply won't fly. Period. The safety of their customers has the highest importance.

There had been rain in the area for several days prior to our trip, and the day we flew,
it was partly sunny with some low lying clouds. So weather was a possible concern.

We took off right on time. Once we got above the clouds our views were unimpeded and they were just stunning. Words simply cannot describe the jaw dropping majesty of this flight. You'd have to see our photos and High Definition videos to comprehend this.

The Glacier landing was spectacular! At that elevation the sun was very strong.  The air was cold, but not terribly so. Would suggest bringing gloves and some good sunblock.

Tony, our pilot, carefully watched an ominous low hanging cloud just over the peak. He stated that if he gave the signal, we had to board immediately and make a hasty retreat, adding to the drama of the trip. But that ominous cloud never brought any dramatic, sudden weather changes to our location. We spent probably 20-25 minutes on the Glacier and took tons of photos. It was incredible.

The return trip back to base was beautiful. The flight, smooth all the way, and not rushed.
Tony's narration throughout the flight was very complete and informative.

Yes, this is expensive. But you'll never have an opportunity like this again.

We loved our K2 experience!

We booked months prior to our trip to Alaska. I called to make the reservations, and they couldn't have been nicer! The day of our flight was finally here and we were excited. When we arrived for check in, they were extremely honest, that the weather was deteriorating, and they could not fly the flight we had booked. They offered an alternate flight for a reduced rate but were very honest of what we would or would not be able to see. They gave us a choice of a full refund or this alternate flight. We chose a refund, which they processed immediately. Their care of customers is unmatched! Kudos!

We did a Denali explorer flight seeing tour with glacier landing on July 5.  I had originally had this excursion booked for three weeks prior to this date, but I came down with covid and couldn't go on the cruise. We moved the cruise to a later date and I called Talkeetna Air Taxi to tell them and to ask if I could switch the excursion to the new date on my cruise and they were so helpful and understanding and made the change with no problem. I really appreciate how flexible and accommodating they were in this uncertain travel time that we are living in with Covid. When we arrived in Talkeetna we were asked to wait in front of a store on Main Street until we were picked up by one of their shuttle vans and brought to their office at the airfield. Once there we checked in, got our boot covers and waited for our flight time. We could see the plane that we were going to go up in and they were doing a last minute cleaning to it. Wiping down the windows to make sure everyone had a perfect view for pictures, which I thought was a nice touch. Finally our group was called to head to our plane where we met our pilot (I can’t remember his name, but he was from New Zealand and he was fantastic!). He went over the necessary safety information and then asked if anyone wanted to sit in the cockpit seat and of course I volunteered. That was the best decision, I got such amazing photos from up there which were unobstructed by the wings of the plane. We had a surprisingly clear day, we had even seen the mountain in her entirety from the ground so the pilot said we would have exceptional views once up at the mountain and boy was he right. There’s nothing that can compare to seeing the enormity and majesty of the range and that mountain up close. The pilot flew all around and switched directions so that both sides of the plane could get views of everything. He kept up a nice steady commentary of what we were seeing and interesting facts. Then it was time to land on the glacier. Our pilot picked Ruth Glacier to land because he said he liked the views from there better and I have to agree after seeing some of the other glacier landing sites that other pilots were using he was right. We were on the glacier for about 20 minutes to take photos, have a snowball fight, and just appreciate the beauty around us. He took photos of each family group with the plane, the mountain etc. I’m usually really picky about my photos and end up deleting most of them but I was pleasantly surprised with how perfect the photos he took were! We loaded back up in the plane and headed back to the airport. The whole ride was smooth with very little turbulence. Everyone that we met at Talkeetna Air Taxi was friendly and helpful. They are extremely professional and most importantly safe. Their equipment is maintained nicely. I can’t recommend this company enough.

Wow!!! This was an AMAZING adventure for our whole family!  It was our daughter’s 16th birthday trip and what a fantastic way to see Denali. Everything about the flight was even better than we had hoped.  Our pilot, Leanne, was so kind and friendly and told us so many cool things about Alaska and the beautiful scenery and mountain exploration. She made the whole tour fun and exciting!
