The glacier landing was epic!  We all loved every minute of our time. Then on the flight back our daughter got to sit up front as “co-pilot”!  We couldn’t have asked for a better adventure for our family.  Would recommend this tour to anyone. Better than 5 stars! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️+

My husband and I booked the grand Denali tour. We were lucky, the weather was good. And we got very good views, total ride time was 2 hrs. And we were on the glacier for about 20 minutes. I would say it’s worth the amount, it’s a good memory for us.

Leann gave us a memorable trip around Denali complete with a glacier landing in Don Sheldon Amphitheater.  Sunny, warm, awe inspiring trip!  Tasted some glacier ice.

The entire staff was extremely friendly, knowledgeable and helpful!  It is  a great team.  The entire experience was top notch!
Thank you for a memorable morning at the foot of Denali

We did the Grand Denali tour with a glacier landing on a cold, rainy Sunday morning. Getting to the airport is easy, checking in was quick, and the prep fort he trip was simple. I believe Andy was our pilot. He was calm, clear, and made sure everyone in my party was comfortable (including my 30 year old sister and was white as a ghost because she doesn't like flying). The plane felt safe, and the actual flying part was smooth and relaxing. After the first 10 mins over the flat lands before the park, we went into a cloudy mountain range. But, the second we got past the first row of mountain, it was breathtaking. He may not want me saying this, but my father actually cried during the flight because of the beauty. Words cannot do this justice. After flying around the range, we landed on a glacier (very smooth and easy landing and take-off). That experience of being on, taking a bathroom break on, and eating of the glacier was surreal. I would say it is a must if you're doing this tour. We then took off and flew back to Talkeetna with no issues at all.

This was out first day in Alaska out of 14 total days. And while everything in Alaska was amazing, nothing beat this (and that sentiment includes my sister who is fearful of flying). There is no way I would send someone to Alaska without forcing them to do this tour. If you do not do this, you are missing out on a truly once of a lifetime experience (unless you are one of the pilots, who get to do this amazing thing every single day).

We chose this company to do a flightseeing tour of Denali with glacier 
landing. They were very professsional, prompt in their responses when arranging the tour. I had no doubts as to the competence of our pilot. Plane was small and views were wonderful. I was disappointed at the overall blasé attitude of the pilot. I realize that these pilots probably do this four times a day and I am grateful for the technical expertise, but for us it was a “once in a lifetime trip” . It would have been awesome to have a briefing of what we were going to see in and in what order right before we took off. Since this experience was very foreign to us, a 3D ground model so we could orient and have perspective would have been perfect. Also, a  more animated clear narration while in the air would also have been good.  At the end of it all I was left with the impression that this company knows their stuff and is technically very good, but they did not show any level of enthusiasm for what they do. I would not use them again if another reliable option is available
The flight had beautiful views of the Alaskan mountains including Denali.  It really helped us to understand how massive the area is and how small we are in the grand skeem of things.

review_title: Save money and go with some other company
review_text: Worst experience compared to every other tour we did in Kauai and big islands, they started 30 minutes late than actual time which was 4.30 pm, thus it made us late for our plans after and due to sunset visibility was low, the tour was biased towards people sitting on right, i was on left side and hardly got views and that was for very short time and generally from far off, felt mislead by their advertising of all window seats, there was so much noise even with headphones on that one could hardly understand what pilot was saying.. not worth the money at all, the boat tour of napali was way better. Due to being late the tour was rushed. The planes were not in very good condition as well.

Must do!  There were three retired couples in our group and the plane was the perfect size.  Viewed all the highlights of the island with an excellent pilot who provided an interesting, informative narrative of the the island.  All of us were delighted with the trip.  All of the tour's employees were attentive, knowledgeable, and friendly.  A great experience!

review_title: A must do when you are on the Island!
review_text: Great views to give you an overall impression of the island without trying to drive/hike everywhere! Our pilot "Piper" was an amazing lady - bubbly,informative, wrote down some turtle spotting tips for us afterward, and yet still professional in all her dealings with other aircraft and air traffic control. We felt a fixed wing plane outing was a better dollar value than the helicopter rides but with similar great views!  Definitely, worth the time and money.

review_title: Highly recommend going with this professional company
review_text: So grateful for this tour. The company is incredibly professional. Due to weather conditions, our air tour was cut short and we didn’t see the Na Pali coast. However, what we did get to see was absolutely beautiful, and we are grateful for the experience. On top of that, the company give us a full refund because we didn’t see the Na Pali coast as advertised, which was so kind of them.

What we could see was very beautiful. Unfortunately, cloud cover prevented us from seeing any of the canyon as well as the "Jurassic Park" waterfalls. Since most of our family are huge Jurassic Park fans, seeing the falls was one of the main reasons I booked this tour. Our pilot, Mark, was excellent. He did his best to make sure we saw all that we could and that people on both sides of the plane could enjoy the views. Another drawback was the time issue. We arrived half an hour early as directed only to leave half an hour late. This tour is not something I would do again.

Nate was a great pilot...full of friendliness and information.  He and Ray weren't sure it was a good enough day to fly in terms of views so they let us decide if we wanted to go which we did.  It turned out to be fabulous!  If this was a so-so day then I can't imagine what a good day would be.  The views were spectacular and we have memories to last a life time.  Thank you!

We had a most beautiful flight with Nate . We were able to see the entire island from the sky. The weather cooperated and we had perfect views of many waterfalls,the canyon ,and the best sunny view of the Napali Coast one could have!Nate took us to the very top of the island and was able to fly into the actual crater that formed Kauia.We would HIGHLY suggest this plane tour to everyone !  Thanks to Jill for working with us and to Nate for his very enjoyable trip!  Definitely the highlight of our visit!  The OHIO group .

It was an amazing, once-in-a-lifetime experience for me and my partner and we were so glad we chose to go with a plane instead of the helicopter tour. We were able to see all of the island on a cloudless day and the 1 hour spent in the air was just enough to go all the way around. Great pilot, very knowledgeable about the island and the ride was very smooth. If you are afraid of heights or prone to nausea, take a dramamine (gravol) tablet, but I was fine without it!

review_title: Am-Plane-Azing Experience overall in less than 90 Minutes
review_text: Initially we decided to skip the tour then we decided in the last minute. Called Air Ventures Hawaii and asked them availability they are amazing they give all possible choices that they can provide. Very responsive and very attentive (I think Trish). We took the private tour, Glad we took it. From the beginning our Pilot (Eric) was so amazing explaining everything about the island. Took us all over the island. He is really amazing went above and beyond the possibilities. Thank you Eric really appreciated for everything you showed us. I haven't been in helicopter ride, but glad we took this one. One more thing, we had one child and Eric was very attentive to everyone. Last but not least, you will have amazing view all around the plane.  100% would recommend.

review_title: Incredible company, outstanding pilot, breathtaking experience!
review_text:
My husband and I visited Alaska for my first time in early August.  We knew we wanted to experience a fly over Denali National Park.  After researching the various tour operators offering this service, it was a no brainer to book with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Not only were their Trip Advisor and Google reviews great, but what sold me was their policy to rebook or refund their tours.  The other companies had a much more rigid refund policy.  For those who have never traveled to Alaska, the weather changes daily and can be dramatic as well.  

We originally booked the Mountain Explorer with a Glacier landing for the first tour time of the day.  There are multiple tour times offered throughout the day, so if the visibility or weather cancels an earlier tour, it’s possible to book a later tour if there is availability.  We left the rest of the day open in our planning just in case.  

Unfortunately, the weather was not great on the day of our tour so they called us to tell us it was cancelled.  The rest of the tour times were cancelled as well.  But they offered to rebook us on the Mountain Explorer tour the next day without the glacier landing with a refund of the difference in pricing, so we rebooked it.

When we arrived for the 4pm tour time the next day, they actually booked us on the South Side Explorer with glacier landing and we still received a refund on the difference in price.  We were happy because we did want to have a glacier landing and we didn’t even ask, it was automatically done!  

Our pilot was Luke.  He was fantastic!  Super chill and greeted us wearing jeans and a t-shirt.  I actually sat in the first passenger seat behind the cockpit and watched him fly the plane.  It was fascinating.  Each seat of the plane had a headset with volume knobs on each ear.   Luke pointed out the names of the mountain formations as we soared around them.  It was magical!  Ruth glacier is huge and glorious in the air.  Unfortunately, Denali was hiding in the clouds but the views of the other mountains was spectacular.

The glacier landing was smooth.  We had plenty of time to walk on the glacier and take pictures.  It was worth every penny to have had the opportunity to do so.

Since we sat in the same seats on our return, Luke made sure to fly back the opposite direction so we could see the views we missed on the way up.  As we left the Denali mountain range, we could see views of the Talkeetna valley and various rivers which were breathtaking!  Smooth landing back at the airport.

Talkeetna Air Taxi is the best company for a fly over to Denali Park, hands down!

The company runs a first class business and all the staff is friendly and courteous as well as very professional! Luke, our pilot was excellent as he navigated the mountains and glaciers! He played relaxing music and he was very knowledgeable of the areas as he narrated the experience and kept us well informed of any maneuvers he was making so we would not be caught off guard.  Landing and stepping out onto a glacier was incredibly unbelievable with such magnificent views. This is a must do activity!!!

My experience was awful. The pilot literally ignored every sentence I had spoken and pretended like we were invisible. He was only friendly to another family that were on the plane with us and offered to take pictures for them and held conversations with them. Meanwhile, the only time he has spoken to us was to check people off before boarding. Through the entire flight, he had treated me and my mother as if we were invisible, not responding to a single thing we said, and did not even look in our direction. Conveniently, my mother and I were the only people of color on the aircraft. I was extremely disappointed at this and had went to the office to file a complaint immediately after we got off. Interestingly, he walked past me as I was talking to someone in  the office and, again, acted like I did not exist. It was an extremely unprofessional and outrageously offensive behavior for a tour company. It was humiliating and degrading. I would not recommend it to anyone I know and certainly would not return. I cannot believe I paid a lot of money to be treated like this.
Excellent company. All about safety. Great views. Smooth ride. Awesome pilot - Chris. We were unable to land on the glacier and a credit was already there.

review_title: A must, words cannot express appropriately
review_text: We took this flight combined with “The Original Grand Canyon Jeep and Safari Tour.”  No words can appropriately describe this awe inspiring experience.  At one time I found myself with my hand over my heart or on my cheer just in amazement.  You listen to information and music with head phones, which adds to the experience.  The plane only holds 8 passengers, each with a phenomenal view.  Captain Jack was very friendly.   I cannot recommend this enough.  It is truly the best way to experience the Grand Canyon.

We booked the full package through Grand Canyon Scenic Airlines: air flight to the Canyon, helicopter trip into the Canyon and river ride, bus tour and Skywalk. The company was constantly professional and helpful. I had to change the dates of our trip twice following a knee injury and the telephone staff handled this perfectly. Unfortunately on the day of our trip temperatures at the base of the Canyon hit 47 degrees and the helicopter and boat trip had to be cancelled as it was too hot for the copters to gain the lift needed to take off. The ground staff were exceptionally professional and courteous and we were given a full refund on the unused portion.

My husband and children (18,19) had a great time on this trip!  The early morning plane ride was terrific, and as we had read before, it’s best to sit on the left side of the plane for the best views!
  The off road driving in trucks to Antelope Canyon was pretty bumpy and dusty- but hey- you’re on an adventure! Our guide Patrick was amazing; a native to the area and extremely knowledgeable about every camera and phone camera! Got us the best pictures! A wonderful guide! 
 The boxed lunches came next, pretty good- only no specific time to eat them. We were starving since we’d been going since 6am and so we ate them on the bus ride to the raft place (even though they said no eating on the bus!) after the informal TSA check.      Our rafting guide, Jerod, was really terrific; super knowledgeable and kept all the younger kids on the boat engaged! The only thing I was disappointed in, was not wearing my bathing suit, as we had opportunity to get in the river, and I hadnt read it was going to be allowed. The rafting was super hot, but lemonade and water are provided, and he put the boat in the shady areas as much as possible when we were stationary hearing about the canyon. 
The walk up to the ptyroglyphs is eh, well, a few carvings on rock- not that impressive- but history I understand. Nice comfy AC  bus back.  Stop at gift store Ok too! Overall we loved the whole trip!

review_title: Incredible experience best way to optimize your time
review_text: I had a great experience visiting Grand Canyon with this company. They took us to Guano Point and Eagle point (with skywalk) in one day, also the flight was around Colorado River and Hoover Dam with incredible views. Highly recommended because my friends who did this trip from Las Vegas by driving themselves told me they spent a lot of time driving in bad highways stressed and they had to book a hotel inside the park to have time to visit it, nevertheless if you go by plane or helicopter you will arrive faster and enjoy one entire day with the best views of Grand Canyon. I Loved it!!

Our family took a day/overnight trip from Vegas to South Rim of the GC and stayed in Valle.  We had booked the plane well in advance of our anticipated travel.  All I can say, is if you have been to the GC, but never viewed from air, this is a must do adventure!  A bird's eye view from above are just very inspiring.  Words/pictures can not explain how powerful.  The operators/pilots, etc. with Scenic Tours were awesome!  We all enjoyed the flight and learned a lot about the canyon as well.

review_title: Best way to do the south rim from Vegas
review_text:
Grand Canyon airlines picked us up from the hotel, and took us to the Boulder airport, the company is ridiculously well organized and every thing went flawless, once we landed at the Grand Canyon airport Jerry, the bus driver/tour guide was great, and more than willing to help out with pictures. 
The flight was rough, but not the pilots fault, just a little plane and hot weather makes for a bumpy flight.

We did the Tour Adventure (this company provides a wide variety of Grand Canyon tours-- you have a lot of options depending on how much time and money you want to spend. However, I do think this particular tour option gives you the most "bang for the buck".) which included a plane ride over the Grand Canyon, a visit to Antelope Canyon, and a rafting trip down the Colorado through Glen Canyon. It takes the whole day (we had to be at the airport near the South Rim by 6 am and were returned there at about 6:00 pm) and is well worth it-- you get a great sense of the whole area. You see the Grand Canyon from above (which is a vaster, more expansive view than you get hiking in it-- a different way to see it than we had the day before), see the canyon walls from below as you raft down the river (though, this is through Glen Canyon, not the Grand Canyon-- rafting waters through the Glen Canyon are really calm while the waters through the Grand Canyon are rougher. This is the relaxed, scenic way to raft the river.) and the breathtaking interior of Upper Antelope Canyon which is open only by reserved tour (you can't just walk in yourself-- you have to have a guide). 
Everyone on this tour, from the pilot to the river guide to the bus driver who took us to our car at the end of the day, was enthusiastic and friendly. It was well run and well organized (and, even had well-timed bathroom breaks to accommodate the long day and the fact that, if it's hot, you'll want to drink a lot of water). The food provided was good-- overall, this is a nicely comprehensive day and a great trio of ways to experience the Grand Canyon and around.

review_title: Do it, do it!! Incredible service and great tour!
review_text:
I am terrified of flying and was really dreading the Grand Canyon tour.
 As we drove to Boulder airport I was becoming more and more terrified. As I walked into the airport a lovely lady who worked there greeted us and I started crying I was that scared. She was absolutely lovely she asked me if I am scared flying. I informed her I was and I was not sure if I could go ahead with it. She said this happens to a lot of people and if I go and check in and have a seat she will come back and have a chat with me.

After I checked in she came back, sat down next to me, explained that the plane is very safe, the pilots are fully qualified, if the conditions aren't safe they won't fly etc. She was so lovely, she gave me a hug and some vouchers for a free drink and a souvenir photo. I felt so much more at ease just by someone talking to me and I am SO glad I went through with it.

I did not get the lady's name during my mini meltdown but I thank her from the bottom of my heart. I did the tour on Saturday 5th October and arrived at the airport very early in the morning before sunrise.

We did the skywalk and had lunch overlooking the Grand Canyon. I was blown away. One of the true wonders of the world. No photos can do it justice.

review_title: No Trip to Las Vegas Would Be Complete Without It
review_text:
Having booked a week in Las Vegas over the 4th July weekend, one of our top priorities was to get to see the Grand Canyon. We originally planned on hiring a car and driving there, but were put off by the lengthy drive and the idea of a whole day cooking together in the car !
Instead, we decided to look at our options for taking a flight over the Canyon. Taking our place in the human mass that ebbs and flows up and down the Strip, we were occasionally cornered by sales or timeshare agents trying to persuade us to part with more of our overdraft (!) in exchange for a variety of trips, shows and events. We quickly established that booking a flight through these agents was going to cost a minimum of $130 each (around £80 in real money) for a plane trip, and substantially more for a helicopter ride. We also learned the hard way, that it's sometimes difficult to extract yourself from the clutches of these agents, if they get even the slightest sniff of possibility that you might take your wallet or your credit card out. So if you intend speaking to them, you have to be prepared to walk away if you don't want what they're selling !

Once we'd established the 'ball-park' cost of a trip, we returned to our hotel and accessed the internet to compare prices direct. Keeping to our budget, we wanted a short plane ride which wouldn't take up all of our day. After some searching, we found GrandCanyonAirlines.com who have a broad spectrum of both helicopter and airplane options available. Their website is easy to use and their prices are far better than most. We booked 2 tickets online for $94 each (around £60), opting for the early morning (6am) flight. Be warned though - the website allows you to check flight availability for the next day but it doesn't tell you until AFTER you've made your selections, that you have to book at least 3 days in advance !?!?! So don't leave it until the end of your holiday to book in. Having negotiated this minor hurdle, we then discovered that our pick-up time would be at an ungodly 4am ! Not the easiest time in the morning to rise after a night of Mojitos and Margueritas ! !

Anyway, on the day, our pick-up was running 10 or 15 minutes late (no big deal) and after collecting four other couples, the drive to Boulder City airstrip took around 40 minutes. The set up there is pretty good and certainly better than I imagined it might be. They have a fairly new terminal building with a small coffee shop / gift store, and enough seating for most. Each passenger books in and is then weighed, to calculate distribution around the airplane cabin. This was particularly pleasing as it made a mockery of those who had raced off the bus to be first in line, shouldering children and elderly folk out of the way to get the best seats - I'm joking of course but there was a stampede to be first in line ! Outside on the apron were numerous helicopters and around the corner sat the airplanes. Lots of people were arriving from different places for a number of early flights. Unfortunately for us, only 4 of the 8 passengers booked on our plane had managed to drag themselves out of bed for the pick-up, and our flight was cancelled. This is something else to be wary of, although you have no control over it. If they don't have the minimum number on the day, the flight is scrubbed. We were offered alternative flights and chose to return next morning at a slightly later time (so we could get more sleep ! !).

Our pick-up next morning was more eventful - Running late again with another family already on the bus, we were then delayed a further 20 minutes at our hotel while we waited for members of said family to visit the restrooms !  What it is exactly that takes 20 minutes, I'll never know ! ! !  However, this is another drawback of these trips and you should be prepared for the possibility that your pick-up may run very late. It clearly caused some concern with those waiting further along the Strip to be collected. Nonetheless, we still arrived at Boulder in time so there was less time sitting around.

So to the flight. The plane was small and cosy with large viewing windows. The crew were very friendly and accommodating. We had headsets that alternated between playing an audio travel guide with useful information on the area, and a cheesy soundtrack that I reckon was taken from "Blazing saddles" !  The flight was nice and smooth (taking into account the odd airpocket that wouldn't constitute turbulence, but which still caused my other half to attempt to surgically remove my left bicep, using only her fingernails and her teeth ! !) And the Grand Canyon itself... What can I possibly say that far better writers than I, havn't already said...?  It was an experience we'll never forget. It was utterly magnificent. It's impossible to convey the sheer scale and magnitude and it was so humbling to fly over it, through it and around it. Driving to the rim would never have afforded such views, so taking the plane ride was money well spent. It was a fabulous journey which also took in the Hoover Dam and it's new road bridge, as well as Lake Mead.

Would we recommend Grand Canyon Airlines? Definitely. 
Would we fly with them again? Absolutely. In a helicopter next I think !
What should you take? Cameras, spare batteries and memory card, cash (for the coffee shop / gift store), sunglasses, water (it can get pretty stuffy if the bus is full).

review_title: Bad service and rude staff - Poorly organised and amateur
review_text:
A party of 4 of us took the Grand Voyager tour in June 2008. The cost for 4 people being nearly $1300. You would expect with that sort of price that your tour would be organise properly. The scenery was great but the tour was poorly organised. 

We enjoyed or scenic flight although the planes look very old and less than well kept. On arrival at the canyon rim we were delayed by 30 minutes on our helicopter tour to the base of the canyon and ended up standing in the 100 degree heat while we waited for the company to organise our flight to the base of the canyon. When we landed at the base of the canyon you are pointed in the general direction of the river and told to find your own way down to the boat which is about 500ft down a rock track - the whole way along people coming up were asking us the way back to the helicopter pad. No clear path or directions marked on the hazardous trail. 

The boat trip was not just that - no commentary to speak of - before returning you to the river bank and you are left to find your own way back up the hill. 

This part of tour was OK but it went all wrong when we returned to the canyon rim via helicopter. We were met at the heli pad by a young lady who passed us a ticket and told us to get on the bus and get off at the second stop - the ticket was our lunch ticket. Written on the top of the ticket was 12.30. No explanation was given that this was time we were to return from the canyon rim bus tour to catch our flight back. The ticket was our lunch ticket so we assumed it was our lunch time and had our lunch at 12.30 and returned to the airport by bus at 1.15. At this time we were told that we had missed our flight back and the next one was 4pm. We explained this would mean we would miss our shows that night and we were told in the shorted possible way by the company representative that was 'tough luck' and they would do nothing about. We explained we were not informed of our need to be back at 12.30pm and they could not care less - in fact the insolence and rudeness of the staff would have to be the worst i have ever encountered. It was not until we made quite a scene that the even tried to get us an earlier flight (to no avail) - customer service was sadly lacking. I have travelled all over the world and this is my 3rd time to the Grand Canyon and never have I enountered a poorly organised tour or service this bad - even in 3rd world countries. 

We were told that on our return on the 4pm flight that they would have a bus waiting to take us directly to our hotel so we could at least try to get to our show. When we returned on the flight this was not even organised. We were delayed another 30 minutes waiting for our bus. We missed our showtime  which meant we lost $520 worth of show tickets. 

On complaining to the company they simply refused to do anything about it  - I called customer service several times before I managed to get hold of them. When asked why they hadn't call back i was informed that as we were international tourists they were unable to call international cellular numbers. This meant that I wore the cost of the calls made to complain - a total of $67 worth of calls. So a tour that should have taken 6 to 8 hours actually took 11 hours and ended up costing us $587 more that the $1300 dollars it was supposed to.  A grand total of $1857 - I could have spent this is with another tour company who would provided us with personalised professional service. 

You would have to be insane to trust your money, time and safety to them to professionally conduct a tour. I am one very unhappy customer as are my travelling companions. Unfortunately the company have my money and I have no way of getting it back. Try a different company - not Papillon thats the same organisation.

This was the highlight of our Alaskan cruise vacation as far as I'm concerned. The entire staff could not have been more pleasant.   Flying over Misty Fjords was simply magical.  The landscape was so unique and IMHO is best appreciated from the air.  We even landed on a small lake and were allowed to stop outside of the plan on the pontoons.  The music just added to the experience.  Thank you all for such a great memory!
This was a last minute booking when we arrived in Ketchikan on our cruise. It exceeded every expectation we had. Absolutely amazing and our pilot was fabulous. Loved the dogs at the dock too!

review_title: The Highlight of our Alaska Cruise
review_text: Seaplane tour was an amazing way to experience the beauty of Misty Fjords! Scenery was stunning throughout the flight. Landing on a lake with the chance to get out on a small lake was a true highlight. Seawind also coordinated with us on our flight time since or cruise ship arrived late, picked us up at the NCL Ward Cove dock, dropped us in Ketchikan after the tour, and later took us back to the ship. They were also easy to get a hold of via phone.
Super fun. Beautiful sights. No bears seen though a different group saw. Half way both us got nauseous. Take dramamine. Other than that it was great.
The tour was awesome, great views of inner Alaska, the float plane was awesome, our pilot seemed bothered when we would ask a few questions, glad he knew how to fly the plane.

We so enjoyed this adventure.  It was a partly cloudy day but once in the fjords, there was a beautiful mist of clouds running through them.  The pilot had great commentary on the fjords and the background music was very peaceful and perfect for the setting. The landings were so smooth we almost couldn't tell when the plane was on the water! There was a little turbulence in the air but not so much that it made anyone sick and one in our group was prone to the that. We all loved the views and the ride!

Generally had a wonderful time.  There was clearly a miscommunication with our pickup and I had to call them to see where they were, we were picked up about 30-45 min late and then had to wait a bit when we got to the dock so that got a little frustrating.  Fortunately we had enough time in port that it wasn't really an issue, just an inconvenience.  But the flight itself was wonderful, nice and smooth which was good because I'm a little nervous on small planes.  But Steve was an excellent pilot, he even banked and turned around so show us a bear on a logging road.  We landed on a dock in the middle of the one of the lakes which was very picturesque.  My daughter got a little airsick and Steve was even willing to fly us to another spot if needed so she could, uh, take care of business with no one else around.  Wasn't necessary but appreciated the thought!  We had "misty" weather which was very appropriate!  Overall a fantastic experience!

This was a last minute decision we made and we are "so happy" that we did fly with Seawind Aviation! The scenery and views were spectacular! The pilot was so nice and the staff including the shuttle driver went the extra mile in helpfulness and showed their generosity by celebrating our anniversary with complimentary "Alaska Beers" ! What a Great Time and Great Memories!
Thanks Seawind!

It was such a pleasure dealing with Lesley. We were group of 14 and the entire flightseeing tour of Misty Fjords was flawless. Everybody at SeaWind  Aviation are very friendly and accommodating. Special thanks to Steve, Ginger and of course Lesley.

review_title: Create the memory of a lifetime
review_text: We could not have been happier or more impressed with this family-run company. Completely professional from the pick-up point at our cruise dock to dropping us off again at the restaurant of our choosing after the flight, Steve and Lesley also set our minds at ease with their friendly and personal attention prior to boarding the sea plane. The flight itself was spectacular with sights that pictures simply cannot do justice and the chance to spend some quiet moments on a small island in what must be one of the most pristine and beautiful places on the planet is beyond words. We would highly recommend using them to help create the memory of a lifetime!

review_title: SeaWind Aviation, Ketchikan Alaska - Great Trip
review_text:
In August 2011, my husband and I had the opportunity to go on a float plane trip to Misty Fjords.  We chose SeaWind Aviation for our trip.  The company is family owned and do a 100% professional job.  
Steve and Lesley Kamm are the owners.  Lesley was great to work with over the phone when making our reservations.  Steve is the pilot and he took us on a wonderful trip to Misty Fjords.  He lands the plane on a lake and everyone gets out to spend some time in the middle of nowhere...with the most beautiful scenery you can imagine.  Steve is very knowledgeable and gives a great tour.
I was a little nervous about going on a small plane, but once we got started I forgot all that and enjoyed the ride.  There is so much to see and such beautiful landscape, pictures just  don't do it justice.
Steve and Lesley do a wonderful job and we highly recommend their company.
I've added a few photos of our trip.

Steve is such a wonderful guy and a great pilot.  He has a great sense of humor and you can tell that he loves what he does!  He takes time to get to know the people on the flight and really makes the experience that much more enjoyable.  
We took the Misty Fjords tours and found Steve through a mutual friend.  The views are amazing and he does a great job explaining everything.  He is very knowledgeable.  Any of his tours are a MUST DO when in town!!

Everything was perfect!  The welcome made by a lovely lady and a very professional Jeff pilot, kind and reassuring. Competent as a pilot but also very knowledgeable throughout the entire plane trip.  A very well invested hour.  It is worth it because the landscapes are exceptional and spectacular. Thank you very much.

This experience was fantastic.  You don't get a close to the mountains and waterfalls as you do with a helicopter, but the value for the cost can't be beat.  Aunt Jill and our pilot Kamaka were fantastic, and made the experience completely stress-free.  I highly recommend using Wings Over Kauai if you have a choice!

Exactly the tour I wanted - as a solo traveler got to sit in the right-hand seat with two other couples behind us - after departing the airport you do a (general) clockwise circle around the island affording plenty of opportunities to see Kipu Kai (the beach from the film "Six Days and Seven Nights"),  the Jurassic Park waterfall & Hanapepe Valley, Wiamea Canyon & the Na Pali Coastline, and Hanalei Bay. Our pilot was very competent and very knowledgeable - turning the aircraft to allow views of everything regardless of the side of the plane where you're seating. Highly recommended.

review_title: No better way to see Kauai!
review_text:
What an amazing way to see the beautiful Garden Island! Our pilot/instructor/guide, Jacob, let me fly while my wife did the photos from the back seat. We explored the whole island from the air which gave us a great preview of all the fun activities we were going to do the rest of our visit. He even gave us some tips for beautiful hikes we could take and he was totally right!

A huge highlight was spotting humpbacks and flying over to see them up close. That was so cool!

Setting up the tour was easy and the customer support by Ellen was top notch. She was very communicative and helped me make sure we'd make the absolute most of our trip. I highly recommend this as a great way to start your Kauai visit, but really is excellent any time.

We had an absolutely amazing experience with Wings Over Kauai. They were very prompt in their responses right from the time of booking till end of flight. The staff was warm and extremely friendly. 

We booked a van for 6 of us and it was like our own private charter. We also got discount for booking early. 

Their pilot was experienced, knowledgeable and did an awesome job with the flight take off, landing and also maneuvering flight during turbulence. We felt extremely safe during the entire time and got to know a lot about Kauai during the flight.  He was very patient and we never felt rushed during the entire flight.

I would definitely recommend Wings Over Kauai for best flight experience in Kauai. The flight was much better than helicopter, as each passenger had a window seat to enjoy breathtaking views of the beautiful island of Kauai.

review_title: Great way to start your visit and get to know beautiful Kauai
review_text: Everything about our flight was spectacular. Marcus is not only an excellent pilot, he shares information that is helpful in making your activities more informed. We highly recommend that you also purchase the dvd of your flight that is done very professionally to share with those you love and to revisit your experience. Gina was very kind and helpful in the office. Our flight was at 1 pm and it wasn’t the perfect time for photography of the Napali coast due to sun glare. A bit of Photoshopping” helped remedy. We saw some beautiful double rainbows. You can’t get as close to the falls as a helicopter would, but the lesser cost is something to consider.

review_title: Really the best way to see Kauai by air
review_text: From check in to touch down, Wings Over Kauai was a highlight of our Hawaiian vacation (October 2019). It felt more “personal” than other helicopter tours we looked at. Being the only couple on board, we really got to know Bruce the pilot. Aside from being skilled and personable, Bruce had an answer to any question we threw at him. You had the sense that this was not just a job, but a passion - sharing his love for the island. Treat yourself to unforgettable views and book a tour.

We are a group of 6 ladies from all over who met in Hawaii yo celebrate 2 of our 50th birthdays.
We included Kauai on our itinerary to see the Na Pali trail only to discover it has been closed for over a year.
We looked into options to see it from the sea or air and founds these guys and are so glad we did. The price point was great cheaper than a helicopter and not so noisy.
Bruce was a lovely fella so calm and caring about those on our party who were motion sick.

Can’t recommend highly enough.

The Wings Over Kauai staff was so helpful from the start. Our first reservation was for the private air tour for 2 on a Cessna. That trip was cancelled so they rebooked us for the air van with 2 other guests on the next morning. It was a lucky change. The weather was perfectly clear. Best part of our flight besides the indescribable awesome beauty of the views, was our pilot Marcus. He was very knowledgeable about all aspects of the island. The flight was calm and smooth.
Marcus took time to spot whales and flew us over a mother whale with her calf and and an escort. Amazing! I highly recommend this company due to the excellent service from the staff. We will be back for a flight the next time!

We did the private 2 person Pali Mist Air tour and it was fantastic.  The best thing we did on our trip was to book this tour.  Bruce and Val are amazing.  Bruce was a wonderful pilot.  We had a great flight and learned so much about the island in the process- not to mention the views of the Napali Coast, Wemeia Canyon and all the wonderful waterfalls we would not have seen otherwise.
Skip the helicopter tours and go this route.  This is a smaller business and the price is  more economical than the commercial helicoptor rides.  You just feel more taken care of.  Val who is the front desk person got us checked in quickly and gave us an overview of our flight.  They are great people.  Please, please check them out!!  You won't be sorry.

We have friends that now live in Hawaii and they strongly suggested that we take a plane tour of Kauai, rather than a helicopter tour. So we searched and found Wings over Kauai. The commuter terminal where they are located, is about a 5-6 minute walk from the regular airport and Val, who met us at the front desk, could not have been any nicer. She took pictures of us outside the plane before we left. Marcus was our amazing pilot and we got some amazing pictures! Many of these beaches and waterfalls we flew over, you could not reach by car and are not part of the helicopter tours. We were presented with CD's of pictures and a Hawaiian playlist which we really appreciated. I will DEFINITELY recommend this to other friends that are travelling to Hawaii later on this year!

My two sisters and I planned a lovely, activity filled Christmas in Kauai. We picked this company for our air tour because of the great reviews. Although the flight was nice (Marcus was our pilot) I must comment on the reception and behavior we encountered from Bruce and Abi. We arrived early to an empty lobby area, well over the 30 minutes you are instructed to arrive. We could see out the back windows to the tarmac and noticed that one of the company's planes had just landed. It was the smaller 4-seater plane; a couple had since arrived and told us they had a two o'clock flight. They ended up leaving without taking their flight tour after a conversation with Bruce. We knew another couple was with us which meant that we would be in the larger 6-seater plane at 2:30. I watched a lady (whom I now know as Abi) placing blocks under the wheels of the plane and the pilot climb out of the plane then I moved away from the window further into the lobby to talk to one of my sisters. As we stood talking, the pilot (whom I now know as Bruce) came in through the door and saw us standing there. The expression on his face was not only off-putting, his actions were the same. He didn't speak or say hello at all, just paused scowled and kept walking. In fact, his demeanor was such that both my sister and I looked at each other in askance. As African-Americans we are the both of us very aware, observant and sensitive to our surroundings and peoples' energy. I was glad that he was NOT our pilot. Later as Abi was explaining emergency in-flight procedures to us, correction, to my two sisters; it was as if I didn't exist. She didn't bother to look at me or include me in that conversation. I am 6 feet tall but I was standing directly behind them in a little huddle. It was incredibly rude and disrespectful of her to treat me in such a manner and I let her know. Later there was an issue of seating arrangements in the plane which I think could have been handled differently. I have extremely long legs and was put in a middle seat when the back row seat by the door had no middle seat in front of it. I had to stretch my left leg out across the aisle of the plane to even fit there. I have flown in many small airplanes before. My ex-husband was a private pilot and flight instructor so I am aware and understand how weight and balance works. I will say that Marcus was polite, professional and his landing was one of the softess I've ever experienced. he would do well to brush up on his knowledge of the pine tree was on the island...We're going back to Kauai again but we will not be giving these people our business. I did not feel at all welcome or like they wanted or appreciated our business, unfortunate but true....
Super friendly pilot and staff. We had a lovely time with Bruce. The flight was very smooth. our pilot told us a lot about Kauai. Definitely recommend it!

review_title: Excellent tour, great narrative and views of the island
review_text: Great tour and really gives you the whole perspective and views of the rugged terrain you can get no other way. Looking down on the water falls, flying in and out of the deep canyons is the only way to see this magnificent island. Bruce, the owner and pilot is very friendly and informative. As I am also a pilot, I did the flying and he managed the radio and navigation so it was a very relaxed and pleasurable experience. I would strongly recommend this tour to all who want to really experience the island that you can only see from the air and also to all pilots who would like to add this to their flying experience.

We debated the helicopter tour or the small plane offered by Wings Over Kauai, and opted for the plane.  For us, it was the perfect decision.  We didn't necessarily want all the ups and downs the choppers take, and enjoyed the steady and amazing flight our pilot Marcus provided.  The plane is the type they use in the Outback and can land anywhere if needed.  Marcus was a true pro and knew everything there was to know about the island.  Mary, from the office, was very helpful, as was everyone in this operation.  You're going to hear about the amazing vistas from all the reviews--I wanted to be sure to commend Wings Over Kauai for the outstanding tour, great service, and true Aloha spirit.  Highly recommend.

Before  getting on a Cessna,  so worried about airplane sick,,,.
Never  nevver  happned  to me.  bit  hot  in a Cessna,  though.
Marvelous  outview,  Waimea,  Hanalei Bay,,,,  splendid. ]
Good  experience  ever.

review_title: Great flight to see all of Kuaui! (Considering motion sickness pills)
review_text: Everyone that greeted us there was very friendly. Our pilot (Josh?) was very knowledgeable of the land history and movies that had taken place there. Although we had very clear sky during the flight, there were sudden small sharp drops in altitude here and there. I normally don't get motion sickness in these type of planes, but did feel a little sick at the end of this flight. Taking a motion sickness pill is highly recommended as a precaution.

My niece had taken a helicopter tour of Kauai and impressed on me that it was the only way to see the beauty of the island. My family and I decided to go with Wings over Kauai mainly because it was cheaper. It was a very smooth flight with Capt. Bruce and the sights were just breathtaking. I would do it again with Wings over Kauai. Everyone was so warm and friendly; service is top notch.

review_title: My mind was in the clouds...
review_text:
I wanted to do something special for my girlfriend's birthday. I've been to Kauai a couple of times but she has not. What better way to see an island for the first time than seeing the entire island...and by air!

Of course I looked on TripAdvisor for help. I started with helicopter tours and trying to fit it in my budget. Then I noticed "Wings over Kauai" a couple attractions below and went to their website. Saw they used those small prop planes (good for those that get motion-sick) and then I saw they had a combo tour. Looked at the price and had to call to confirm....it was no joke! The price for both the air and sea tour was only a little more than the helicopter rides.

I called them to book the tours. The receptionist was very friendly and helpful. Helped me upgrade to a smaller plane (not much more) so we would have it all to ourselves. Emailed me the details and confirmation right away. Was no trouble at all.

When we arrived in Lihue, picked up our rental car and drove literally only 5 mins to arrive at the office/plane. Definitely recommend, if possible, to book your air tour the day you arrive because it's so close to the airport and you won't need to come back to the area if you plane to stay outside of Lihue.

The girl working in the office was very friendly and also the pilots daughter. We waited a few minutes for the pilot to get the plane ready and we were off. They let us take pictures in front of the plane and will even give you a CD copy of your our after.

The pilot was nice, friendly, funny and best of all knowledgeable. Told us some stories and history about places we were flying over. He interacted with us when we asked questions. He was so personable that he made us feel comfortable and relaxed (definitely helped me because I easily get motion-sickness).

If you're looking to do something different and you're on a budget (or if you easily get motion-sickness) then I highly recommend this company. It's family-owned so they take real good care of you and make sure that you have an awesome experience. Great way to see the entire island in an hour.

review_title: Cannot imagine what could have been better...
review_text: Flew with Bruce and my family of five, kids aged 12, 8 and 3.  All of the kids loved it, maybe not as much as my wife and I.  Bruce was very informative and genuine in his love for what he does - fly people to see some of the most stunning places on the island.  The ride was smooth, no sickness whatsoever even with a few bumps.  To see what we saw would have required a few days of trips around the island - all completed from the best view (some that you cannot see by hiking or by car) with a great captain.  And we got to choose a co-captain, would recommend to anyone.

This was the highlight of my 4 day trip to Kauai. Everyone we dealt with at the company were lovely ,even advising us to change our flight from 24 Nov to 25 Nov as they believed the  weather would be more favourable. The company supplied DVD was a great way to show family at home what we had seen. The pilot Bruce was very knowledgeable and provided a really good commentary with the flight. I would highly recommend this to anyone it was a great way to see the island. If I get the chance to return to Kauai I will certainly be doing this again.

review_title: Fantastic way to get some air time with awesome views and instruction
review_text: I purchased a flight with Bruce ( instructor) for a refresher for my husband who has not flown in years.  Bruce was fantastic. Great instruction, calm and great island commentary. We saw all the awesome stuff canyons na Pali  coast beaches waterfalls.  It was a fantastic tour and a great opportunity for my husband to fly again. A great company to deal with. We loved it and were very grateful for the customized free hi lites video as well.  Would highly recommend. Also FYI much more cost effective and smooth ride than a helicopter.

review_title: A must-do in Kauai!! The highlight of our trip!!!
review_text: We HIGHLY RECOMMEND Wings Over Kauai! Starting with the reservation and emails with Ellen through the actual flight, our experience with Brue and Ellen was like none other! Bruce is an amazing pilot and showed us a great time.  We flew around the island (just three of us) and saw the beautiful mountains and waterfalls of Kauai.  The view of the Na Pali coast was breathtaking.  Bruce knows so much about the nature and history of the island owning to his scientific background in the field of agriculture, so the flight was just as educational as it was thrilling.  He also knows the weather patterns and will take you out at the best times, when the sky is clear and you can see everything.  Smooth ride, absolutely stunning views of the island, and an unbeatable price.  Definitely the highlight of our vacation!

This was definitely the highlight of our trip to Kauai. The majority of the island is not navigable by land, so your only option is a boat tour or air tour. We didn't go on a boat tour, but I don't know if anything else could have compared to this. 

First off, the couple who runs this place is extremely nice. We had a reservation for an afternoon tour, got there, and they said that due to weather conditions, they could bring us on a short tour, but we wouldn't be able to see most of the island because the clouds were so low, so they let us reschedule and let us know that if things weren't better, they'd give us a call so we wouldn't have to make the trip out. 

The day of the tour, thankfully, was nice just when we were ready to go out and the views are seriously breathtaking.

Scared of getting into such a small plan? I kind of was. The pilot is also an American airlines pilot, and the flight was incredibly smooth. The take off and landing in the small plan were really fun, and the ride was pretty much turbulent free. They even provide drinks AND blankets to make the trip that much more enjoyable. 

You all get to wear headphones so that you can talk to one another over the sound of the engine and the pilot is super knowledgeable about a ton of fun facts about the island. There's also music in the background that will keep you entertained throughout the trip through paradise.

I know it's a pretty penny to be spending, but if you're going to Kauai, you don't want to miss this!

review_title: Incredible Way to See the Whole Kauai
review_text:
We love this air charter tour company and have taken their tours several times while on Kauai. Most of Kauai is not viewable because of the terrain, so seeing the island by air is a must at least once while on the island. Wings Over Kauai offers a comfortable air tour of the entire island with spectacular views of the most popular and breathtaking sites the island has to offer, including: waterfalls, coastlines, Waimea Canyon, the inner island, sugar plantations, resort areas, and open sea.

On our last trip, we were thrilled to see several pods of whales swimming in the open sea from the air. Incredible! Throughout the ride, you'll hear about the island (including some history) from the friendly pilot through noise-cancelling headphones. The plane is small, carrying only about 8 passengers and they are always on time with their flights. Be aware that harsh weather will sometimes interrupt the tours, so it's a good idea to call ahead if the weather looks ominous. The flight leaves from the Lihue airport - very easy to find their hanger, just past the main terminal. 

The plane tours offer a much more affordable way to see the island, as opposed to the helicopter ventures. Wings Over Kauai also gifts you with a lovely DVD as a thank you gift for taking their flight. My spouse and I will be watching our videos (both theirs and those that we took in flight) many times to remember this special trip. Highly recommended.

This review is for the Grand Deluxe tour with Kauai by Air. The tour covers most of the standard spots in Kauai including Jurassic Falls, Napali, Waimea Canyon, etc. 

Experience (5/5) - The experience was amazing at every customer touch-point. Our initial conversation during the data gathering and reservation was candid, honest and direct without any high-pressure sales. This is followed by the first in-person conversation where they Bruce and Ellen warmly invited us into their office to collect additional information and address other flying logistics, rather than dealing with the customer at the counter. They are also well prepared with some interesting reading materials while the customers wait for the plane logistics to work out. The actual flying experience is amazing as well. Bruce is a very good pilot and guide who immerses you in the overall flying experience. He's extremely knowledgeable and beyond pointing the standard spots he understands Kauai's vegetation very well (he used to be an agro-scientist before). Finally, at exit they awarded us with a CD that had one of their tours on a bright & sunny day.

Pricing (5/5) - Fly by Kauai has one price, that is honored any way you contact them. This makes shopping far more easier. While doing our research, we came across groups that would change the price depending on the discount coupon/magazine you're holding.

Ethics (5/5) - I felt it was important to highlight this category because I've read nightmare experiences across some other reviews across their competition in Helicopter and Air. The case in point is where the second group did not show up due to a scheduling error. Bruce came by to tell us that they will need to change planes because the # of passengers had reduced. Unfortunately, their smaller plane did not have enough fuel and since it would take more time to refuel the plane they took us flying in the original larger plane, at the expense of their profit. A lesser group would have delayed the trip or made us wait longer till the smaller plane was refueled.

One other aspect I want to highlight is for people that get motion sick easily. I am one of those who feels nausea after an hour long boat ride. Given that, an Airplane ride is a safer choice rather than a helicopter ride as they tend to change altitude much more rapidly. So for all of you who get motion sick easily, I would recommend that you go for a plane tour. Note that this does not guarantee that you will not get motion sick, but it reduces the possibility.

review_title: Great flight lesson/tour combo with free seat for your partner
review_text: Take the little Cessna, ask Bruce for the right seat, have your partner sit in the back (very comfortable and windows on both sides), and do a mixture of a tour, sightseeing and flying yourself.  Bruce is incredibly knowledgable about the flora, fauna and topology of the island and this made for a great commentary.  Despite arriving 30 mins late we were made to feel very relaxed, and despite having originally booked a 90 minute flight, due to the late arrival it was reduced to 60 mins with no charge and it was still plenty of time to see all the sights. Having taken a couple trial flying lessons before I was also keen to have the opportunity to take the controls.  Bruce was excellent, putting me at my ease and allowing me to take off and land and fly some of the round the island circuit (at least using the yoke). Great fun, good experience, lovely touches including the free photo emailed to us, flower and necklace for my wife and and all round friendly experience. Highly recommended, at $220 for two people, also great value regardless of if you want to take the controls or not. Also, I suspect, much safer that the helicopter tours.

Flying with Wings Over Kauai was a wonderful experience.  The reservation process was easy and they were very flexible in order to accommodate our schedule. When we arrived everyone was extremely friendly and the checkin process was a breeze. Bruce informed us there was some haze and checked the weather to see if the next few days would offer better viewing.  Since there was some rain in the forecast we decided to go that day, and we were happy we did. We took the smaller Cessna plane.  Bruce was a wonderful pilot - it was an extremely smooth flight and Bruce was a great guide.  And the sights were awesome.  This is a great alternative for people who are nervous about helicopters (like me) or who have weight limits and cannot take a helicopter.

review_title: Wings Over Kauai is Professional with Top Operators
review_text: I chose Wings Over Kauai for Flight instruction and a tour of the island with Captain Bruce.  The first thing I noticed was Bruce's professionalism and smooth flying of the Cessna.  He really does keep the passenger's comfort and enjoyment in mind at all times and knows the island very well.  I would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone that asks.  No better value on Kauai.  You will be treated right!

This was my first experience of this kind. and I am glad it began with this operator.  The crew ( Capt Josh, Ellen and Ciera) was excellent. We arrived an hour early for the 11'o clock ride. The team checked us in and guided us to Wailua falls that was hardly 5 miles from their office which I covered in 40 min. Capt Josh was very informative and ensured that we all engaged in an interactive conversation. We especially liked the way he pointed out the scenes from Hollywood flicks that were shot in various spots in the island. Now about the view, I simply think even if you cover the spots by land or sea an aerial view is unmatched for. The hidden falls, canyon and Na'pali coast line are just few spots that are insanely beautiful that you should see from up in the sky! You will never regret the experience.

review_title: Awesome tour and definitely felt safe!
review_text:
I've never taken a small plane tour before so I didn't know what to expect, but it was a fantastic way to see the island and it wasn't scary at all!  I popped a Dramamine an hour before the flight, but I probably would have been fine without it since pur pilot, Bruce, flew and landed the plane super smoothly--all while giving us lots of trivia and facts about Kauai!  There were 4 passengers on the plane and we all had great views out our windows!!

I really enjoyed the experience, especially the unexpected ginger chews, kukui nut lei, and photographs they gave us! :)  And the $120 price point was much cheaper than the price point the helicopter tours were charging.

To see Kauai you need a plane tour. Wings over Kauai doesn't use helicopters which fly lower but cost $50-$100 more per person. Being family run its very personal. There are 4 window seats to the right and you get one of them without any surcharges. The first one next to the pilot requires helping the pilot a bit but is probably the best one specially if you are tall enough to see thru the front window as well. The last one is the smallest but its easier to avoid the wings in your photos from that seat. In the 1hr trip you see everything worth seeing including Jurassic falls from a distance. They gave us a DVD of the trip free in the $120 price. Overall it was 4.5 stars not 5 as the plane was old - you could tell from the seats, wing nuts, fuel leaks, scratches on the window etc. Also the DVD wasn't filmed with a high def, even my pocket camera could do better. With some upgrades they would be 5 stars.

My husband and I traveled to Kauai for our 25th anniversary and scheduled a couple of things based on reviews that I read on Tripadvisor.  Everything positive we read about Wings Over Kauai was absolutely true.  From the beginning stages of booking online they were very personable in their communication.  When we arrived we were greeted with enthusiasm.  The ladies get a lovely necklace and flower as a welcome gift.  The plane was very comfortable and they included a small cooler with drinks, wet towels in case you got a little queasy and mints to help as well. Bruce was so informative and you can tell he loves what he does.  The views were absolutely breathtaking.  When we landed we were given a very nice DVD of the sights we had seen with our picture on the cover.  It was a super day.  As my husband and I waited for our flight another group from a different tour company returned from a flight and they were very quiet and no real interaction with each other...when the group from Wings Over Kauai returned you would have thought they were all old friends.  The laughter and ease with this group and the crew spoke volumes and told me right away that we had chosen well.  Thank you to Ellen, Bruce and Kathy for a wonderful wonderful day!!

Had a great flight with Wings Over Kauai. I really liked the personal touches that Bruce and Ellen added.  When I arrived a was given a shell necklace and flower to wear behind my ear.  They both took the time to get to know my boyfriend and I.  We were given bottled water during the flight.  Bruce often referred to us by name and genuinely seemed interested in learning more about us.  Bruce also shared many things about what was going on in his life as well and how he came to live in Kauai.  It was like we were flying with friends.  After the flight we were given a dvd that had our picture on the cover.  We were on a small aircraft with just my boyfriend and I and Bruce.
Great time!

Just read the last review and have to agree with every recommendation made. 
Book this first or a helicopter tour before you start the rest of the vacation so u  know what to do. We did and it was the best idea i had. Carry a light jacket. Its funny how cold it gets up there. 

Bruce and Jennie are lovely. We were late because of the kids and cause we got lost. They were super nice about it. We did get lovely surprises from them. They do go the extra mile. 

I will say that you will be flying higher than the helicopters so keep that in mind. They cannot get you as close and dont have the ability to hover (obviously). The view is still breath taking and Bruse is really knowledgeable. I loved the tour. My husband has a fear of small planes so he was not so thrilled. He loved the view just not the plane. Bruce is an amazing pilot. I felt safer with him than on my Delta flight into Kauai. The windows are wide and you do get  great view especially if you are sitting on the right side of the plane.

For those with young children under 4: I wish i knew this so i am telling you. I chose the airplane tour because i was concerned about the noise factor with my 2 1/2 yr olds. Helicopters are loud and I was concerned that my kids would get scared so  chose the plane. Well the plane is also loud but  the kids got this sound reducing ear muffs which for some reason my kids liked and kept on. (God was on my side cause normally they would never have worn them) When you go up the plane needs to be balanced and no one is allowed to move from their seats so this can be hard on the kids. My daughter had to sit by her self in the middle row and it was not easy. Not Bruces fault just kids being kids. If you can, get a babysitter and leave them at the hotel/resort. It will cost less and you can enjoy the sights better. if you cant. I recommend you get they tired enough that the plane noise will lull them to sleep (mine did in 10 mins of being in the air)

Well, there really is a reason that this is rated number 1 for attractions and activities...there really is no downside.  Firstly, making a reservation by phone or online via their website is easy, painless, and Ellen replies promptly with the most polite and genuine response.  
For us, on the day of our planned tour, the skies from Princeville looked gloomy and there were scattered showers, so I called Ellen because I was concerned.  She immediately gave me the option to go later in the day which we chose to do, but the skies cleared beautifully anyway shortly thereafter.  As an aside though, I saw several helicopters flying through rainy and gloomy skies that morning, which would have really stunk for the money they charge.
Bruce greeted us at the airport and everything ran so smoothly.  The only issue is that we waited for another couple who had also reserved the flight, and they never showed, which held us up.  In addition, they could have allowed someone else to reserve those seats, so if you aren't going to show, please provide common courtesy and make a simple phone call.
You will always get a window seat on this flight, and you will get to see everything there is to see in Kauai on a very comfortable, easy flight.  There are fantastic photo ops, which is beneficial because the flight is slower and steady, and you are up in the air for around 70 minutes.  Bruce is well informed about the island and points everything out there is to see--he's done the flight over 5,000 times.
This truly is a steal for the price, and turned out to be the highlight of our trip.  Seeing the Napali coast by air turned out to be far better than by water, and having gracious, genuine hosts for our tour made it that much better...

We had a fantastic time.  They went out of their way to provide a great tour with a personal touch.  Our 2 y/o and a 6 y/o were greeted with stuffed bears as well.  In addition to the great tour, we were provided a tour DVD along with emailed photos of the family (next to the plane). 

I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai.

This was our first ever flight tour, and we felt like we were in good hands the whole way with Bruce in control. He is an outstanding pilot and tour guide. The most unique aspect was Bruce's perspective on the flora, due to his extensive background in Agronomy. Ellen was a wonderful host, and gave us great suggestions for must see/do activities on the island. This was the highlight of our trip to Kauai.

review_title: Excellent trip, great service, fantastic people!
review_text: In searching for a Kauai flight, I came across Wings Over Kauai Tours. The reviews and their commitment to service won me over and I am very glad I chose to fly with them.  Both Gy and Ellen make you feel very welcome and they are genuinely interested in each passenger.  You feel like you have known them for years!  The weather turned out to be excellent, the trip was smooth, Gy was very informative about all that we saw and we got great views of all the beauty the island has to offer.  It was an excellent experience from beginning to end.

Plane tour (versus helicopter tour) over Kauai. Owner/operator picked us up and dropped us back off within a very short walking distance from Pride of America Cruise ship. Airport is less than 10 miles from Cruise ship. Tour is done in small airplane. Myr tour was done in smaller 4 seater airplane - I rode upfront with pilot with wife and child in back seat. Took lots of pictures from both front and the back - so definately bring camera. Tour lasted a little over an hour in the air.

Owner operators are very customer focused and make you feel like you are their most important client. 

Price is  approximately 1/2 the price of a helicopter tour.

Highly recommended !!!!!

We took the Pali Mist tour with WOK today (Friday). Making the reservation was very easy. I called their # on Thursday morning and Ellen took our information (name, hotel, weight, when we would like the tour). We were concerned about the weather as it has been windy the whole week and my husband was prone to motion sickness. She said that the ride can get bumpy at times and most people were able to tolerate without getting sick. 

The morning of the flight, it was overcast and windy. On our way to the airport, it even rained a little. We were greeted by Ellen 30 min before the tour at the commuter terminal. She was very friendly and gave me a flower from her garden to put in my hair and a lei. She then got us ready in the plane (cooler with drinks, seat belt, window etc). Take-off was nice and smooth and we were on our way to some fantastic views. We hiked a few trials and saw some of the sights earlier during the week and it was really neat to see the same sights from air: the Na Pali coast (via Kalalau trail), the Hanalei bay (via Alaka'i Swamp trail), the Waipo'o falls (via canyon trail). The most amazing was we saw many sights that could only been seen by air. That made the trip really worthwhile. Bruce gave excellent narratives throughout the tour and pointed out the sights for photographs. Overall it was a wonderful trip. I would have given a five-star if the weather were more cooperative. We did not get sick but the flight was bumpy at times due to the wind. I would highly recommend the trip. After all, it was only $220 for two and we got the plane, the pilot, and the beautiful sights all to ourselves.

review_title: Wings Over Kauai - A Cut Above
review_text: Knowing that my wife, Valerie, wouldn't consider a helicopter experience over the island, (neither would I) I researched WOK and talked her into the flight.  WOW!  We totally enjoyed the kindness and trust in Bruce and Ellen.  We were going to fly a day earlier, but the weather conditions weren't the best so they rescheduled us for the following day.  Val was the copilot and helped Bruce with the checklist.  After checking for birds, we were off.  At half the price of a chopper and so personalized, just the three of us, you couldn't ask for more.  Make sure Bruce demonstrates the Bose noise cancelling headset.  Incredible!This flight was the highlight of our week on Kauai.

review_title: The Most Amazing Flightseeing Tours of Kauai
review_text:
Just recently returned from a trip on Kauai, Hawaii.  Had the most amazing flightseeing experience with Wings Over Kauai.
Before leaving the ground, the flight operator/pilot's main focus was safety and comfort.  He was well prepared for flight, made everyone feel at ease, and was extremely knowledgeable about the different land forms, mountains, canyons, coastline, different areas/neighborhoods, and yes, even whale watching.  His  courteous and easy going style made this trip enjoyable, interesting, and fun.   What a great experience!!!
Put this one at the top of your list of things to do on Kauai.

Linda & Donovan
New York

review_title: Unfair experience - not good value for money
review_text: Everyone paid the same price but the experiences were vastly different depending on where in the helicopter you sat.  I sat in the back in the middle and had a very restricted view compared with those sitting in the front or next to the windows.  Also the pilot did some manoeuvres to show aspects of the Grand Canyon but he did not do these equally on both sides so my daughter missed a lot of views and experiences even though she had a window seat.  I realise that weight has to be balanced and that not everyone can have the same view, but then don't charge everyone the same price! It is highly unfair that the people at the front had panoramic views and I had to try to see past the people either side of me and look through their windows.  This excursion is a once in a lifetime event and should have been a wonderful memory, instead it was an expensive and poor experience.  My advice is don't bother  - there is no guarantee that you will get a good view.

If anyone gets the chance to do the Grand Canyon, please do it. I took the family over this year and was simply amazing. To have my wife and kids there was simply incredible to say that we have sat and had lunch in the Canyon is out if this world. 
Make sure you go with Maverick as they are great. Our pilot was tremendous and full of great knowledge in historical information. Yes it is not cheap but is something you will remember all your life.

Friendly service and well worth it. The best way to see the canyon. Try and get a window seat if possible or the front row.
Would recommend this to anyone

If you can do this trip. Flying over and through the canyon really helped us gain more perspective on the vastness of the Canyon. And we got to see more of the Kaibab forest so that was neat. The pilot was nice and explained about the area and geology.

The 45 min flight through the grand canyon is mind blowing. After a 5 minutes flight over the kaibab forest you enter the cliffs of the canyon and its just fantastic. The pilot explains background and names of the various rock formation. 
Bad Luck: My friend and I catched the seats on the back which did not provide an ideal view - I wished this would have been mentioned in advance and would have been taken into acaount in the pricing. Anyway: great experience

My wife and I took a 45-minute morning tour from Tusayan airport.  The weather was perfect: sunny, clear blue sky, and no wind.  It was a fantastic trip.  Our pilot put my apprehensive wife at ease by making her his "co-pilot" and having her sit next to him.  He hovered to allow us to take pictures and videos from several different angles and provided an educational narrative about the canyon.  He had a great background music track and answered questions while in flight.  This was the high point of a 24-day road trip that covered four Western states and took us into British Columbia.  Initially hesitant to take the flight, my wife hasn't stopped telling friends and family how great it was.

We had Alex as our pilot. He was very good. Check in fellow was not as friendly. Acted as if my booking through a "third party=trip advisor" made my business less valuable to them. If you don't want third party bookings don't make the deal. Anyway, flight was good.  Helicopter had a lot of vibration that was a little disconcerting. Views were beautiful. Would recommend.

I wish there were 10 stars...then I would give this trip an 11! An absolutely amazing experience. Flying over the forest to drop into the Grand Canyon literally took our breath away. This flight is a marvelous way to see the Grand Canyon. BJ was a great pilot/tour guide. He was knowledgeable, funny and made the flight extra memorable. We felt very secure with Maverick Helicopters. We had originally scheduled this trip for the day prior. Maverick cancelled after sending pilots to check out the route and determining it was too windy to fly. We appreciated Maverick's caution and happily drove 2 hours the next day to check this item off our Bucket List. Bring your sun glasses and camera and don't forget to take video. We did the 50 minute flight and could have flown longer. There is a 30 minute flight available too but we were very happy with the longer flight. We loved every minute of this experience and our 11-year old will never forget it. Neither will we.

My partner and I had never been in a helicopter before, and she is scared of heights, but BJ our pilot was excellent, he talked us through the journey and was informative about what we were seeing, he gave some background and history of the area, and put us totally at ease.  It is expensive but well worth the money as it is a once in a lifetime experience, would recommend it to anyone.  We flew from the Grand Canyon airport and everything went like clockwork, BJ checked if he had anyone on board that was afraid of heights, and the trip was incredibly smooth, the helicopter had good visibility and seated 7 passengers though we only had 5 on our trip, an excellent insight into the canyon for our first glimpse.

review_title: Worth every penny and many more!
review_text: a thrill of a life time! One of the few things in life that you'd pay more than the asking price if they had you pay afterwards. The pilot was very professional and an excellent guide.

review_title: Great way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: I looked at a lot of options before coming to the conclusion that Mavrick was probably the best rated helicopter ride over the canyon. There are longer rides, but truthfully a 40-50 minute ride is enough. The pilot was knowledgable and did a great job flying, even with a little bit of wind. The one thing I regret was being one of the interior passengers in the second row of the helicopter. The two interior seats of the back row have the worst views. The pilot assigns the seating, theoretically by weight distribution, but our flight was all about the same and I got the middle by luck of the draw.
