Still a great experience, just not as great as anyone in the front or the side two seats in the back.

review_title: Great way to see the Canyon
review_text:
I have flown with them twice- very professional and a stellar view of the canyon. I will say though a lot depends on your pilot. My first trip was exciting and the pilot had great music to accentuate the trip.The second time the pilot was playing Yani and it did not add to the experience
I would recommend though as there is no other way to appreciate the immensity of the cnayon.

review_title: Great experience for my son in wheelchair
review_text: Most of the people can hike, walk,explore The Grand Canyon. But people with disabilities can not do a lot of things to really know this wonderful place. Flying over the Canyon was the best experience ever for my son in wheelchair and the whole family. All the seats are great. Expensive but definitely worth it!

This is a bucket lister for sure. We called one day ahead and made the reservation with ease. I must say the young men who answered the phone had some of the nicest manners I have heard in a while.  The reservation was easy, and although they couldn't provide transport to the airport, we got a cab through the front desk at the Maswik. It was 27 bucks each way for 4 adults to be driven out of the park and into the little town of Tusayan where the airport was located.  The office is very nice with comfortable seating, gift shop, snack bar, clean restrooms.  They weigh you, and then you wait til your pilot comes and calls your group. We were a family of four, plus 2 singles, and the pilot, with one empty seat. They tell you where to sit according to weight distribution, so no fights about getting the front or back row.  Our pilot was BJ. and he was very clean cut and personable and prfessional. He also cracked a few jokes and posed for a pre flight pic. He tells you all the rules, is very calm and reassuring. This was my second heli flight so I knew what to expect, but nothing can prepare you for the moment the craft flies over the edge of the canyon. What a freakin thrill. We flew over the canyon for about half an hour before heading back over the rim and back to the airport. The whole time B.J. pointed out landmarks and answered questions and cracked jokes.  This trip provides you with unparalleled views. They also video tape the whole flight so you can enjoy it later without having to worry about a viewfinder. Highly recommend it if you can swing it moneywise, you will not be sorry.

We booked this company through Via-tor in order to see the Grand Canyon.We wasn't disappointed. Although the we had to reschedule due to the weather( by one day) it is certainly worth it Our pilot Mark (think that was his name) did us proud. We saw as much of the canyon as is possible(we had the 45/50 minute tour).Any questions that any of us asked he answered with the knowledge and knowing what he was talking about. When you fly out over the pine trees is something but then you can see the edge of the canyon then suddenly the ground drops away and you are over the canyon in all it's glory.Really would recommend this experience.

We arrived for our pre booked flight to be told that the weather coming in would effect the hour tour we had arranged and that our flight would have to be reduced from an hour to 30 minutes, Maverick agreed to let us wait for an hour to see whether it would clear but when the weather become worse (in fact it made the press here in the UK as a weather phenomenon) they swiftly got us up in the air to view the Grand Canyon and we are so grateful that we got to experience the Canyon from this angle.  The weather is obviously out of their control but they kept us posted on the progress and ensured that we got to see as much as possible.  There really is no other way to view the Canyon, you don’t get an idea of scale on foot.  Mavericks helicopters are far superior to their competitors and well worth the money, our pilot was lots of fun and taught us lots about the Canyon too, an excellent way to end our trip.

review_title: Unbelievable helicopter trip over the Grand Canyon
review_text: We were first in the air the day we went - it was a beautifully sunny morning and the ride was so smooth.  Our pilot was great fun and pointed out all the sights to us.  The views are truly breathtaking.

Maverick tours are a very slick and professional company. There was 8 in our party and we had a great day. We couldn't fault any part of the tour and Bruce our guide was informative and made sure we all knew our schedule and drop off and pick up points along the journey. Although he probably had done this in the morning he was enthusiastic as if we were his first party of the day. He also allowed us to take some wonderful photos of the wild life by driving very very slow. The pilots were very, very lovely and allowed the passengers to go to the cockpit to take photos as we were flying over the amazing landscape. They were very patient with our 13 yr old who was more interested in flying than the views and although he took more time chatting they happily accommodated him. Great day had by all and well worth the price. 

Thank you everyone, specially the pilots and Bruce

Piper was competent and knowledgeable.  The plane seemed to be well maintained.  Piper started with a thorough safety check and ended with a nice landing with some cross wind. Will recommend to family and friends.

We had a blast going on the Big Kahuna Kauai Air Tour.  It was fantastic to see the island this way and gave us a different way of appreciating the beauty of Kauai.  Our pilot was informative, nice, and friendly.  It was easy to arrange the tour and everyone with whom we met from this company was respectful and had smiles on their faces (it makes a big difference when communicating with someone with a friendly smile and demeanor!).  I highly recommend this company and the tours they provide  We will be back again someday!

Safety is vital in the 6 seater passenger plane took us around the island on a beautiful day.  Our pilot was excellent, skilled, reassuring, and knew his way around his island like the back of his hand.  It was hands down one of the most splendid and stunning adventures I have had in my long lifetime and I am grateful for having taken it with Air Ventures.  Without a doubt one of the most memorable experiences of my lifetime.  A hands down unhesitating recommendation!

Small plane scenic tour on  the Hawaii Island of Kauai was one of the highlights of our cruise around the Islands in March 2019. It is definitely the way to see the many site seeing attractions and the  tour operators were both friendly, professional and extremely good value for money. Not to be missed,if you get the chance. Jerry & Gill.

This trip was awesome and reasonably priced. The pilot was energetic and offered tons of information about the island (I am always impressed when people can maintain a high level of energy, even though they probably do the same exact tour every day). This was a great way to orient myself with the layout of the land on Kauai, and the views of Wiamea Canyon and the Napali coast were spectacular. The trip was just the right amount of time at around 60 minutes.

I would recommend Air Ventures Hawaii for your Kauai vacation.

Ray is really an awesome pilot!He took us right up close to some cliffs,mountains,waterfalls,valleys and beaches without any kind of danger.You feel safe with Ray flying you.He gives detailed explanations of the stories and history of the places you fly over,as well as a very informative overview of Kauai's incredible history!Fly with him,you will be SO GLAD you did!!YOU DON'T WANT TO MISS THIS ONE!!!!

We are so glad we took this plane tour!  The pilot was nice and very knowledgeable about the history of the island as we flew over old volcano craters & how they formed Kauai.  We went on the 1:30 flight & the clouds were high so we could see the Na Pali coast & the rest of the island.  We had a small amount of turbulence, but we did fine.  Kevin was our pilot with 28 years of flying experience behind him!
We would do this again, we loved this tour!

My friend and I were in Kauai celebrating our 50th birthdays and wanted to do something memorable together. When our commercial plane arrived in Lihue, we saw this yellow bi-plane parked near where we taxied in to our gate. We both said we needed to look into that!!!! So we did and booked a flight with our very experienced pilot Kevin. We were so excited to be doing this flight, but Kevin made it even more exciting for us. He taught us everything we needed to know pre-flight and then even after take off he was able to communicate with us through the headsets we had. He gave a wonderful description of everything we flew over...this included the resort area, up to Waimea Canyon (where we flew right down the middle!), came back over the coastline to the Napoli Coast. To add some excitement to our flight, and because we asked him to, he did a flight maneuver with us! Actually did a loopity loop over the water! All we good was giggle with excitement!!!! The tour continued over Princeville/Hanalei and then turned into the center of the island where we flew around the volcano, saw numerous waterfalls, including Wailua Falls! I cannot say enough about how fun and interesting this flight was to see so much of the island and to get such a detailed commentary from Kevin! I highly recommend this flight!

This was one of the best experiences of my life. Kevin did an exceptional job at pointing out various landmarks and giving the history of the island. If you've never ridden in a biplane and find yourself in Kauai this should be at the top of your to do list! There really isn't a better way to see the island.

review_title: Lovely views of the whole island
review_text: From the moment I called them, they were helpful, polite and easy to schedule. Once we were in the island, they were very informative about the weather and when it would be better to fly, we had to postpone the flight twice b.c of weather conditions. The day we went, it was great. Plane is a little stuffy, need more air circulating around, but its probably the same with any small aircraft. Plane was in great conditions and they offer cold towels and water on board if needed. A picture was taken at the beginning and was emailed to us to keep.

From the time that we arrived, the staff did everything possible to make us welcome and comfortable. The guide/pilot Kevin was excellent and wanted to make sure that all had a great experience. The flight was smooth and comfortable and we saw awesome sights of Kauai. Would definely recommend this to all.

review_title: The best way to see Kauai!
review_text: This was a great way to see the island of Kauai. It's probably better to become a little familiar with the island before taking the flight though. It could be hard to see some of the points of interest if you don't know what you're looking for and having seen them at ground level first will definitely help. We had a great flight and were able to see 3 whales which was truly amazing!! Make sure to take something before hand if you get sea sick. My husband thought he would be ok because he doesn't have a problem in bigger planes but ended up feeling nauseous in the smaller plane. Our pilot was great in helping him feel better during the ride but I would definitely recommend using a patch or Dramamine before hand if needed. Each member of the crew was very friendly, helpful, and dedicated to a great customer experience which always makes a huge difference and I really appreciate that. Overall I was very pleased with this experience and would do it again in a heart-beat! If it's something you're considering I'd say go for it!!

We picked Kauia destination for our honeymoon, but as far as we wanted to make the trip brilliant we came to Kauai un prepared about doing an Air tour ! We were worried we wouldn't have the time to do it since it was just a quick 4 day honeymoon trip. I'm glad though that my AMAZING husband found Air Ventures Hawaii right away . They respond and called us back in less than 20 minutes. Thank you Gil and Kevin! JUST SO EVERYONE KNOWS Kevin was great pilot and great tour guide! He described  all of the history of the island that we wouldn't have known! He's the most experienced pilot in town of Kauai, and Gil OMG ! She hooked us up and got an upgrade . Thank you so much , seeing the beauty of the  whole garden of Kauai was once in a lifetime experienced ! !!

Took a 70 minute flight with my two young daughters, the Gippsland GA8 (airvan) is a comfortable aircraft, each passenger has a bubble window suitable for photography, and cold bottled water is available throughout the flight. Guests were provided with headsets and could interact with the pilot at any time over the intercom. 
As the flight departed Lihue, our pilot Paul was quick to point out features such as Mount Waialeale, Wailua falls (Fantasy Island), the Kilohana Crater, Poipu Beach, along with the Kauai  Coffee plantation.   As we travelled along the black sands of Waimea (with the forbidden island of Nihau visible), we turned north for a spectacular tour of the Waimea Canyon and the many waterfalls along the way. One of the more thrilling moments of the tour is occurs when the jagged cathedral hilltops fall away to reveal the Napali coast, on this flight we were lucky enough to spot a couple of grey whales breaching. Our flight circled the Taro fields and waters of Hanalei Bay, where our pilot pointed out some of the homes of the wealthy and famous. We continued east toward Kilauea lighthouse and wildlife sanctuary prior to continuing south passing features such as the Sleeping Giant, Fern Grotto, and the Wailua River.
Our pilot's narrative was highly informative in terms of local island history, natural history, popular culture, geology, and current events. He also offered up some of his own opinions on great spots for surfing, snorkeling, and meal choices. I would highly recommend this flight as one of your first activities on Kauai as it provides not only a visual feast, but a brief yet thorough education on what sets the Garden Isle apart from the others.

Three of us went on the tour on Mar 16. We got there early and were warmly greeted and told we could leave early. Our pilot was very knowledgeable of the air and went to great lengths to make sure we saw all the sights. While up there we saw a shark eating a baby whale and then later saw 4 big whales and one baby whale. I would suggest anyone looking for a great experience at a reasonable cost this is the one to choose. Great company!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Took to the air with Air Ventures for a flight around Kauai. Comfortable modern plane, great pilot and great weather. Managed to see whales off shore , as well as great views of this lovely island. What a backyard to have to show off to visitors. Thanks to the staff at Air Ventures for a great trip.

This fixed wing circle island tour with Air Ventures was the highlight of our HI trip!  The views were awe inspiring, the narration extremely informative, comfort and safety an utmost concern.  Bryan, our pilot, was funny and a pleasure and Pua in reception was very sweet and helpful.  After six trips to the Kauai, I finally was able to see the interior of the island, along with flying over the wettest spot on earth!  I would highly recommend this activity!

My husband and I were thrilled and 100% satisfied!  After booking with Air Ventures we were a bit skeptical because their price is unbeatable!  Other companies charge twice as much. But after the tour we couldn't have been more pleased.  Our tour guide was funny, informative and very knowledgeable! We will take this tour again wteb we return and highly recommend Air Ventures to all who would love to see the island from above without paying a high price!  Thank you!  Dan and Evelyn

We took this sightseeing flight around the island Kauai with Air Ventures. Their website is www.airventureshawaii.com. We paid $125 per person for a 1 hr tour. The tour was in an air van that seats 6 people plus the pilot. It was comfortable. The pilot talked to us through our headphones and we asked questions using a microphone. We saw the whole island, the coffee plantations, Waimea (Grand) Canyon, the famous waterfalls in Jurassic Park, the Na Pali Coast, the beaches and golf courses, Julia Robert's house and even a whale slapping the water with his fluke. The tour itself was great. But the wait was ridiculous. We were picked up near the cruise ship terminal at 9:15 am and arrived at the airport at 9:20 am. The tour was supposed to start at 10:00 am, but it did not start until nearly 11:00 am. Since our time in port was short, every minute counts so we did not like having to hang around the airport when we could have been sitting at the beach or shopping.

Thanks Harry for a smooth flight and delightful information about the island.  The sights were spectacular. You can really see the differences of each side of the island.  My only compliant was my setting, near the wing and supports; it was difficult to get some shots with out including them.
But overall, LOVED IT!!!
ellajeff96

An excellent flight, with great views of Kauai and a very informative narration by our pilot Paul.
This was a great way to see this very scenic island and added enormously to our understanding of the island as a whole.  We would highly recommend this activity.

On August 25, 2012 we did an AirAdventure Tour over Kauai. It was a fabulous day for weather...meaning the skies were clear with very few clouds. We were able to see many things that are otherwise not visible because of the weather. The amount of hills and valleys on this small Island are amazing. It didn't appear to be all that small. There are many waterfalls that we were able to see. The coastline and Napali Coast are absolutely beautiful. Everyone gets a window seat and can take many pictures. I took over 200 pictures during the hour which will provide lasting memories of our air tour. The staff at Air Adventures were all very nice and the pilot was constantly pointing out points of interest as we were flying. This was a great tour and was a great value in comparison to other tours.

The Air ventures staff met all our requests and then some. This was a flight for our Anniversary and what a special flight it was!!! The pilot was wonderful he spoke just enough and reminded me to look up in between taking my pictures and he was correct!! The views were great overall, and also could see all the details. The weather was perfect and we could see from one coast to the other.

My wife and I took a 50 minute air tour with AirVentures and were flown around the island by Captain Harry in one of their two Gippsland GA-8 AirVan single engine fixed wing aircraft.  The plane holds about 8 people and has high wings (over the plane) and large slightly curved windows which allow for good viewing.  Do wear dark clothing without patterns to reduce glare off the windows when taking photos.  I got to sit in the co-pilot's seat which was an added treat.

Captain Harry provided a good running commentary on the surroundings.  We flew southwest from Lihue just north of the southern coast, over the Waimea Canyon area, and then up the Na Pali coast.  On the north side we flew around the Hanalei Bay area and then cut across the island back towards Lihue.  We saw a gorgeous ground rainbow as we were coming in for a landing.

If you are prone to air sickness, it is highly recommended that you take some medication prior to boarding the plane.  My wife struggled with air sickness during the flight.  Also, if you are looking for up close views of the waterfalls on the island, the helicopter tours are probably the way to go.  We saw several helicopters that were providing their occupants with very close views of waterfalls while we were several thousand feet above them.

All in all, this was an excellent trip and good value.  AirVentures provides a good overview of the island and allows you to locate areas that you might want to see from ground level.  Do try to schedule this trip early on in your visit.

review_title: A bird's eye view of the whole island splashed with multiple rainbows
review_text: This was probably the most rainbows I have even seen in my whole life.  The air ride gave an up close look at all the best spots of the island.  The mixture of rain and sun brought out rainbows time and time again, including a circular rainbow which was so neat and unique.  Harry also gave a very informative commentary of much of the history and the interesting background to Kauai.  Thanks for a great experience.

review_title: Birds Eye view of Kauai - well worth seeing
review_text: While 3 of the 6 of us did get motion sickness it was the # 1 attraction for those who didn't. While a little surprised at the noise level, I was awed at the majestic view. Everything looked like a painting. The island is just God's artwork and beauty. You get a new perspective from the air and I am glad we did it.

Great experience from friendly booking agent to professional extremely knowledgable pilot.  We have two young girls (4 & 6) and we all got great large window seats with  noise cancelling communications to allow us to talk to each other in comfort in an airconditioned (very welcome in August) spacious cabin.  The ride and view was fantastic and I would recommend this to anyone.  This was significantly cheaper than comparable but shorter helicopter flight I have been on with better viewing (my opinion) and more relaxed atmosphere.

review_title: View of Kauai from the air
review_text: What a great experience and wonderful way to see Kauai!  The ride was relaxing with exquisite views with highlights pointed out along the route by the pilot.  All this at a lower cost than a helicopter ride.  This was a highlight of our vacation in Kauai.

Great view of Sausalito, San Francisco Bay and the city. You fly along the coast at about 1000’ looking at the sites then you gain a little altitude and go across the city viewing Golden Gate Park and the Presidio. You end up South of the Golden Gate Bridge over the Pacific Ocean. On the way back home you fly directly over the bridge and back to base. On a clear day it is a pretty spectacular 30 minutes.

Alaska is absolute beauty and there is no better place to see that than with Talkeetna Air Taxi’s flightseeing Denali with glacier landing.  Words don’t describe the majestic beauty. Everyone at Talkeetna Air Taxi was efficient, safety conscious and so helpful. Liam was a wonderful pilot!

 If you are trying to talk yourself out of doing this tour, re-think the decision.  You truly don’t want to miss what Talkeetna Air Taxi
can show you of Denali’s beauty!!

This was one of the highlights of my trip to Alaska! We had a beautiful day in September. The glacier landing was definitely a must do and I was definitely in awe. Our pilot and tour guide was amazing. She took care of us and was super knowledgeable about everything about Denali. I would do this tour again!

Did the Mountain Voyager with Glacier Landing.  We went in the afternoon at 1.30. It was questionable if we were going to get to go because of weather.  Luckily it cleared enough to go.  Need to be flexible or understand that the weather can change and your trip will be canceled.  Our plane had our family of 7 and 3 others. The Mountains were amazing and it looked like were were very close but were not. Took about 30 minutes to get to the glacier and landed.  We were there about 15 minutes and then flew back. Tour was about 1 3/4 hour.  We all had headsets and the pilot explained what we ere seeing. This was one of my families  favorite tours.  If I had to pick taking the bus tour of Denali or doing this tour,  I would pick this right away.

We had a fantastic experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi! These tours are extremely weather dependent, so don't schedule this for your last day in the the area, just in case you need to reschedule! We chose the Mountain Voyager tour with a glacier landing, and although we had some clouds, we were able to land on the Don Sheldon Amphitheater section of the Ruth Glacier, next to the Sheldon Chalet. It was so much fun to land on the glacier, and the subsequent take off was very cool! As an aside, we were happy to see that Leighan was our pilot, because we love showing our teenage daughter what women can do! Our daughter sat in the copilot seat on the way out, and although she has Asperger's and has a lot of social anxiety, it did not matter to Leighan in the least. :-) Thank you to TAT for a great morning!

One boat took us from the Marine and in the middle of the islands we were transfered to the seaplane.
It was wonderful. 
I am local and I have experimented several tours in the area. This is very good. We took the tour around Downtown and Miami Beach and it was amazing. Really nice views and very smoothly flight, even when our pilot said it was a little windy.
Jorge and Aldo were our captains for the boat and for the seaplane. 
I am very pleased with the experience.
Advice: check weather before booking. Clear sky makes the experience even better.

review_title: greatst views of miami and key biscayne
review_text: courteous service, nice plane, safe, spectacular views! Key biscayne looks amazing, so does downtown miami. it is not the best experience if you experience motion sickness. Otherwise is safe, not scary and worth the money.

I've been wanting to fly on a seaplane for ages, and when my parents came to visit it seemed like a perfect time to check it off the list.
We took our tour on a DeHavilland Beaver, and from the very start, our guide was great- he even carried me out to the plane so I wouldn't get my shoes wet! He gave us a history of the plane itself as we prepared for take off on the water, and continued to trickle in facts about the sights we were flying over. There was enough info to be interesting without being overbearing, so we could still enjoy the experience. The scenery was beautiful and covered a lot of ground (and sea, ha!)- we even saw manatees from the plane!
Definitely recommend and would love to take another sea plane outing!

review_title: Miami Seaplane and Everglades Airboat Tour.. A.M.A.Z.I.N.G.
review_text: Wow where to begin ...This was one of the Best Ever Tours we’ve ever done. Our Seaplane Capt Anderson was Brilliant, I’ve been on a bigger Seaplane before but never one so small this 1969 Cessna 101 packs a big punch, Truly was an  incredible experience. Capt Anderson Talked us through the whole flight. The views over the Miami skyline to the Everglades were pretty incredible...Stunning in fact...Once we landed on the Everglades our Airboat Tour Guides were  waiting to greet us, Wow what another fabulous experience this was our first time on an Airboat and our Guide was so knowledgeable of the area and introduced us to many different sizes of Alligators we managed to get close up and personal with them while our Guide fed them bread allowing us to touch the skin on their  backs and leg pretty awesome experience. After our Everglades tour which lasted about 45mins to 1hr we linked back up with Capt Anderson for our Seaplane flight back to Miami on our return journey Capt Anderson gave us a nice tour of the Miami skyline with more great  commentary.. This really was a Birthday Treat of a lifetime, absolutely Loved it..This is the best way to see the  Everglades do it in style...Highly Recommend... Thank You Capt Anderson for being a terrific Pilot...

From the first moment Tony put us in a relaxed mood 
After introduction and seating in the plane we took off across the water for a very visible and knowledgeable journey to Everglades park . Seeing Miami from the air on both journeys with a running cometary.
Everglades park was stunningly remote with a local guide from Native stock our Airboat trip was full of thrills and wildlife.

We recently went on the this tour and our gps for Uber sent us completely in the wrong way so important in Miami to put every detail of the address! so we arrived about and hour and half late. The pilot was so nice to accommodate us and still take us up. The flight was lovely and the pilot was so good at telling us lots about various places and building. Very nice trip would do the day time one nice time I’m over. Really so so helpful

We stayed in Miami recently (late July/early August 2013) for a weeks vacation. Two trips were booked. One to Key West and the other a seaplane tour. 

Because of poor weather our flight was delayed for 48 hours bu are we glad that eventually the weather improved and we could take up the seaplane tour of Miami.

Our pilot was superb. Made us very calm before take -off and then once in teh air flew us with great professionalism over this wonderful city. He explained everything there was to know about Miami - so much so that our 30 minute trip literally flew by. Do it again ?  You bet we would.

At first i was a little mad, we had a tour booked at 10am and the pilot showed up late
But then everything went great, he was very polite, and super fun
We had a blast!!!
But waaaaaay expensive $150 per person for a 30 minute ride is just insane.

review_title: The flight was excellent but they charged 15% tipping on full price without authorisation
review_text:
So I bought 4 Groupons at $75 for our family (a total of $300) when we visited Miami in June 2012. The booking process was very easy. They answered the phone promptly, had our Groupon codes down and sent us a boarding pass for  2 flights as we split into two parties as we take turn to look after a young baby. They told us that tax and gratuity were not included and if we want to pay by credit card we should call one day before or we will need to pay by cash to the pilot. I called the day before our flights and said I want to pay the tax by credit card and will give the pilot tip in cash. Knowing Floridan tax is about 7% that would be roughly $20 so I didn't ask them to confirm the total amount charged. 
The flight was very enjoyable. The pilot has a lot of local knowledge and was very pleasant. He told us that he owns this company and two planes and he is going to buy a new bigger plane.
My husband said that the pilot shouldn't expect any tip as he would make a lot of money from this business. However, I decided to tip him because I enjoyed his talk about the area.
We received an invoice of $110 in my email stating "GT for flights". I called them up to clarify. The same lady who took my credit card confirmed the tax was $20 and the rest was for gratuity I said I only authorised the tax charge and I already tipped the pilot and that I never authorised them to do that on my credit card. She told me I need to talk to Tony. The first thing he asked me "How much did you tip the pilot?" When I told him, he said bluntly "That is not customary. It should be 15% on the full price of the flights which is $600 if you didn't buy from Groupon". Thats why they charged me $90. He asked or "offered" me if I want to get a refund of $40 for the tip that I already gave the pilot.
I believe in tipping but it is for service people who earn $8.50/ hour at restaurants/ hotels who rely on tipping for their living. However, for a pilot who earns a high wage or owns his own company, tipping should be at customer's discretion, not by forced tipping which is the case here.
What I also found that their attitude was defiant about the charge when it was clear that I did't authorise it. What was not transparent was they didn't itemise the tax charge of $20 in my $110 invoice but indicated it all as GT for gratuity.
I wondered if they did that to avoid the tax and try to capture the discount they offered on Groupon. I have written to them to request the full refund. I hope to hear from other people's experiences.
Great value! The pilot was very attentive. He also gave us a narrated tour. Excellent!!! Beautiful views

review_title: Excellent Way to see The San Fransisco Bay Area
review_text:
I booked a 45 minute sightseeing flight with Seaplane Adventures, as a birthday surprise for my wife and to round off our Californian vacation with a lasting memory.
The team were warm and friendly and the whole experience was excellent.
I particularly wanted to fly in one of these radial engined Beavers and I wasn't disappointed.
My wife loved the whole flight.
It's a memory we will keep as one of the highlights of our Vacation.
Thank You to all at Seaplane Adventures.

review_title: Seaplane Adventure much more than we expected
review_text: Our recent Seaplane Adventure was fabulous! Aside from the novelty of taking off an landing on water we were treated to a sightseeing adventure along the Marin County coastline, past the Golden Gate Bridge, along the San Francisco waterfront, over the Bay Bridge, over Giant's stadium, and over Alcatraz. I've lived in the Bay Area all my life and this was perhaps the most spectacular viewing I've had of San Francisco and the bay. Our pilot kept pointing out interesting points and never made it sound like he had seen it all before and was just going through the script. Highly recommended!

This was my most spectacular experience ever flying over iconic sites in San Francisco Bay. Seaplane Adventures staff were kind and generous from the start to the end. The pilot was a knowledgeable historian who took his time to explain the history behind every site we flew over. I strongly recommend this this to anyone wishing to see San Francisco from a different perspective.
Nick and catherine , birthday trip to the states from the UK . Thoroughly enjoyed the flight, felt confident and st ease with our pilot .

A once-in-a-lifetime experience offering the best aerial views of San Francisco where our pilot showed us the entirety of the city along with its local landmarks including Sausalito, Muir Woods (in the distance), the Golden Gate Bridge*, Alcatraz, Crissy Field, Fisherman's Wharf etc etc. Not only was the pilot exceptionally knowledgeable of San Fran but the entire experience represented excellent value for money where we were able to see the city from above over a 30 minute period (which is more than enough time).

My partner and I took this trip, booked through Viator, in September, during our 3 day stay in San Francisco, while travelling California. We were picked up efficiently and on time from Pier 39, by a friendly and engaging driver, who happily pointed out local sights for us both on the way to Mill Valley, where the seaplane is based and back again. This guy was so informative and helpful, he even stopped twice on the way back so we could take photos of Landmark sights.
The flight itself was great! Our pilot Aaron, was clearly very skilled, confident and experienced in flying the plane. He made sure that everyone (there were four passengers in total, maximum would be five) could ask any questions they had, using the headphones with mikes and gave a really good commentary of the areas we were flying over, throughout the roughly 40 minute flight. I was really lucky in being 'co-pilot', sat at the front. This meant that I was able to lower the window beside me from time to time, to take photos without glass between the camera and the outside world. Having said that, the glass was very clear, so other than possible reflections, pictures would have come out really well anyway. We happened to be flying on the last day of the Americas Cup race and being one of only three airborne vehicles (the other two being media helicopters) made the experience even more special, our pilot making the most of this occasion for his fortunate passengers.
Overall, a very highly recommended trip and very good value for money!

Really excellent for seniors - we saw much more than we'd have seen hiking.  Unforgettable scenery. The flyover was smooth all the way and the pilot was expert, friendly, and highly knowledgeable on the history and geology of the area.

We so enjoyed doing some Christmas shopping in downtown Moab! And want to give a BIG shout out to Allysa Keogh for staying late and helping us pick out gifts jewelry, bags and coffee mugs.  Our family loves them! 
#shoplocal #moab #redtailair #christmas

review_title: Kim Ruble made my first flight fantastic!
review_text: I was a little nervous, never flown in a small plane but Kim was great, made us all very comfortable.  He pointed out all the interesting features and had lots of great stories about the various sights and the old legends that went with them.  The Maze and Needles area of Canyonlands are things I would probably never see any other way.  The colors of the rocks and formations are just impossible to describe, go see it!

Kim at Redtail was one of the most friendly and knowledgeable pilots I could have been lucky enough to fly with.  He is just one of those people who you really know loves everything he does.  Incredible views and a great responsible pilot.

review_title: Flight up river for a rafting trip
review_text: We flew with Kim from Redtail up to the launch point for our Green river rafting trip. This particular morning was quite challenging in terms of the weather conditions and the extreme crosswinds made it impossible to land and made for quite a bumpy ride. I appreciated Kim's extensive experience in flying that helped keep us safe, and he exercised the appropriate amount of caution and decided that it was best to turn back and not to try and force ourselves into a dangerous situation. We turned back to Canyonlands airport, and after the weather had cleared we flew back up there and had a perfectly smooth landing. Kim is a great pilot and made sure that we stayed safe even when Mother Nature wasn't being agreeable. Thanks!

review_title: The gorge from above is a must see
review_text: Totally worth it. It’s such a cool perspective on the gorge. How often are you able to get a 360 view of the gorge from 1500 feet?! The pilot was so friendly with cool facts about the area. Will definitely go again next time I visit.

review_title: Great experience and service, but not properly advertised
review_text:
I first want to state that our pilot Spencer was wonderful in every way. He was very invested in our experience from start to finish, and my rating would be "excellent" if it only pertained to him. I'm being generous by saying "average," simply because I hate to reflect badly on him in any way.

I'm not sure if my complaint should be directed to TripAdvisor (who does not appear to have a way for me to contact them directly) or with the provider company Envi. The writer of this booking description did not prioritize the customer experience by providing accurate information. 

My brother and I booked this tour as a Father's Day gift for our dad - planning that all 3 of us would enjoy the experience together. We were specifically seeking a helicopter ride, and booked this trip only because it was advertised as such. Although we were asked to give the weight of one person at booking, I couldn't find any information that stated a maximum weight for the group. When we arrived, our first surprise was that we could not all 3 be included in the ride. Spencer was great, and he figured out a way to allow us to book a second trip so we could still all participate, though this doubled our cost. The second surprise was that this was a plane tour instead of a helicopter tour.

Spencer did everything in his power to make this a fun outing for us, but he couldn't turn his plane into a helicopter and he had to charge us for the second trip. We made the best of a pretty disappointing and unexpectedly expensive situation, but we will not be trusting TripAdvisor descriptions in the future.
Excellent Pilot!  Little windy and a little bumpy, but he explained exactly where and when we would experience turbulence.  Beautiful views up the Columbia River Gorge.

review_title: Better than Vegas and the Grand Canyon
review_text: I don't know how this company doesn't have thousands of reviews. My wife and I had been on helicopter tours in Vegas and went on an airplane tour over the Grand Canyon a couple of years ago. They were all fun and the views were cool, but it wasn't cheap. My wife and I visited Portland and thought it would be fun to do something similar, shopped around a bit and found Envi. I can honestly say that the experience is not just worth every penny, but we got way more out of this flight than we did in Vegas and the Grand Canyon. It was such a good time and the price was completely reasonable. We highly recommend Envi if you're visiting Portland, or even if you live here. Book a flight if you haven't already.

I grew up here in Portland and went to the gorge every weekend basically. I’m as Oregonian as you can get, my blood is green, stumptown coffee infused and mixed with rain. I thought I knew my Gorge, but now seeing it from above, in a slight drizzle, cloudy, afternoon day, seeing the Gorge, I was speechless. It was all green, the water was blue, everything was perfect. I highly recommend taking a flight from Envi. It was perfect. Absolutely beautiful. Take the flight. Bring your friends, make some awesome memories and take some beautiful photos. Absolutely worth every penny I worked for to fly!

We did the wonderful waterfalls scenic flight in early February and could not recommend it more. Was an absolute amazing experience, with an exceptional staff. If you are in the Portland area it’s worth the short drive to Troutdale. Envi Adventures truly has something special going on. Could not recommend more.

We took an 8pm flight in late July hoping to catch a nice sunset in addition to the falls and we were not disappointed (I’m sure it’s getting even better as the days get shorter)! Our pilot, David, was very funny, full of interesting information, accommodating, and made us feel at ease. We even left something behind and one of their staff met us at about 9:30pm to give it back to us — wow!! Too sweet! Definitely recommend the tour and the company!

review_title: There are alternatives, don't let hotel lock you into flying Westwind
review_text:
As an earlier reviewer mentioned, one of the Westwind planes (not the "Executive") has a "bench" at the back- with only a waist belt and no padding- which I was unfortunately assigned to (when the pilot planned the seating for weight distribution, as is always done, but could have been differently., but I was the last to board). The top of the window was below my chin when sitting on that bench, it's much higher than the seats. I am 71 and have spine degeneration, so I'd  phoned in advance specifically to confirm that the padded seats and window type shown on their website is what we'd all have (the bench is Not shown). 

Instead, I was crouched over on a hard bench to see out of the scratched windows, and it was miserable. They now deny I called, and say they routinely put elders and even handicapped guests on the "bench." So, beware, they're either lying about this to me or they're regularly putting guests in that painful position, for hours. 

They blamed the hotel concierge, and fabricated other excuses. The 3-hour flight was supposed to include, as Lindsay explained in person right before the flight, a glide down into the canyon, a memorable experience only a plane could provide. But we did not do it. The conditions were good. There is other misrepresentation in their website, for instance, the seats and the planes are no longer in that condition, but show a lot of wear. 

My family is in aviation, and I had confidence in Josh, the young pilot, to fly but not in his decision on the seating, and no confidence in the manager, Brad, who bullied me for complaining and requesting a refund. I regret trusting Hilton's Boulders Resort to arrange the canyon flight using Westwind. They have given me a 50% refund, but still blame me for having the "wrong expectations", and my spine is still painful.
Great experience! Our pilot, Max, was awesome!! The entire day was perfect. Thanks to everyone at Westwind and especially Max- what a memory for our family!

Our Lake Powell/Glen Canyon/Rainbow Bridge/Grand Canyon/Horseshoe Bend tour started in Page, AZ. Our pilot, Max, was fantastic - very pleasant, informative, and professional. It was out daughter's 17th birthday, and she was able to briefly take controls and fly the plane - what a birthday to remember!

Apart from the last 10 minutes of yesterday we had an awesome day...my son and I both had to use sick bags just as we were coming back into Sedona! Lol
I found the tour on trip adviser and after a couple of emails back and forward between Australia and Arizona we knew that this was the trip of a lifetime. 
It’s hard to pick a favourite bit of the tour as the scenery was awesome from start to finish, our Pilot/ tour guide Henry was fantastic and we loved his sense of humour.
I think we were a little spoilt because it was just the four of us and apart from the queue for lunch and the queue for photos on the airwalk we were straight into everything. 
The food for lunch was probably my least favourite part, but who could argue with the view while eating it. 
Definitely lived up to, and even surpassed our expectations, even with a little air sickness.

review_title: Fabulous tour by air and by jeep
review_text:
Worth. Every. Penny. 
We were going to drive from Phoenix to Grand Canyon and visit for a day and thought it would be way more fun to go by air and land. Googled this place and they did not disappoint. At $549 per person, 8 of us got into a very comfy tiny plane and flew over Sedona, flagstaff and the Grand Canyon. Spent 30 min over Grand Canyon alone. Landed and took a pink Jeep tour (included in the piece). Our guide was Lucy and she was absolutely awesome. Spent about 2-3 hrs on land with her. She provided us with lunch (sandwich, chips, cookie, apple and water). Flew back to Phoenix in same plane. Cannot remember the pilot, but he just had twins, so congrats and thanks for a terrific day and experience! We will never forget this day!

Our family of 5 thoroughly enjoyed the Adventure trip.  The trip itself is amazing and spectacular, something to truly be seen in person; pictures don't capture the scale of the canyon (4,000 ft to the bottom!). Westwind service was excellent, with particular emphasis on our pilot, Mark.  Mark made the trip very enjoyable.  Professional, engaging, humorous and patient.  However, the highlight was the helicopter tour to the bottom of the canyon.  (The helicopter tour is booked through a separate company that Westwind hires.) Also, the staff at the Canyon is mostly local tribe people and they were also very friendly and offered very good service.

A few suggestions:  Westwind offers water and snacks at the departure airport.  Take plenty as there was only a fixed lunch offered.  We had a back-pack to stuff items in and it came in handy.  I would have taken more as we didn't stop for water except at lunch. Arrive early/or at least on time.  The area up at the Canyon gets very busy with tourists (primarily Chinese) from Vegas.  Westwind has planned the trip to get there a few hours before the tour groups descend on the area.  Our group was delayed (we were put with another family) about an hour and we saw how things could really get busy.  It worked out OK, but something to keep in mind.

review_title: Amazing trip to the Grand Canyon!
review_text: Highly recommend this trip!  Mark our pilot was great..very conscientious with a great sense of humor!  He made us all feel comfortable..especially those of us in the group who were a bit nervous about flying in a smaller plane.  We had a pretty smooth ride over Sedona on the way to the Grand Canyon...breathtaking to see the red rocks from the air.  The highlight was flying over the Grand Canyon!   The pink Jeep tour portion was also great..our guide Hailee was fun and knowledgeable!   Highly recommend!  Take your Dramamine if you are susceptible to motion sickness though!

Unsurpassed professionals guiding you to a "once in a lifetime opportunity" to see both Sedona and The Grand Canyon from the comfort of an airplane.  Fire up the GoPro for this adventure, you will want to share it with family and friends. 

See more than you can possibly see from any ground tour.  The 2+ hour round trip had a fabulous - experienced military veteran flight captain, an audio tour and plenty of tunes to entertain on the return flight.

We were fortunate enough to have a private tour from Sedona to the Grand Canyon and back.  The views are SPECTACULAR...the flight originated and returned to Sedona where we were staying.  We covered the same amount of terrain that would have taken days to achieve on our own - without the crowds and mileage spent on the road.

The flight completes a figure 8 around the Grand Canyon, providing for epic views that you could never see on your own.  Then you circle around Sedona's famed canyons and Red Rocks before a picturesque landing on to the Airport Mesa. Then sadly the tour ends and you still can't believe all that you have seen. The peace, serenity and unsurpassed beauty and wonder will remain with us for a lifetime. 

Not cheap, however, do the math between your time, mileage, food, lodging, navigation issues and crowd interference...not to mention the remote sites...and you truly come out ahead.  Especially, if time is limited - this maximizes your site seeing ability.

review_title: First Time Flyer in Small Plane - Wow!!!
review_text: My wonderful friend treated me to the trip starting in Phoenix to Sedona then over Grand Canyon- many views then pink jeep trip on land from airport in Grand Canyon takes you to several wonderful vantage points which you get history and great pictures from both pilots and do pilots.  We had few hours of jeep tour, which includes yummy lunch, then back on flights for more wonderful views of the canyon and history and tales of the area.  As history buff, I was amazed and the views are spectacular-more than spectacular. we even stopped at the famous El Tovar Hotel and were treated to Hopi Indian dances featuring a darling 3-4 year old  I'll never be able to repay my friend for her generosity as this was truly a day I'll always remember ✈️

review_title: Westwind Left Me Speechless - but in a good way!
review_text: Very rarely am I rendered speechless. But when I was recently surprised with a Westwind adventure to the Grand Canyon, that’s exactly what happened. From the moment we arrived and were greeted by Gayle Lurenz, we felt like VIPs and our excitement began to build. As Gayle described our itinerary for the day, I could hardly believe how much we would experience in just 8 hours. We departed Phoenix on our private 9-passenger plane with our expert guide and pilot, Captain Ron. The views became more and more stunning as we landed on the mesa in Sedona. Then it was off to the West Rim of the Grand Canyon where we rode in our helicopter over the rim and down to the bottom of the Canyon for a boat ride along the Colorado River. As if that weren’t enough, we ended our adventure with lunch and even more stunning views from the Skywalk Bridge. By the end of this very special day, I couldn’t believe the dent I had put in my Bucket List. If you've ever wanted to enjoy a truly unique way to enjoy the magnificence of the Grand Canyon, Westwind is the way to go!

We took the Page to Monument Valley, with Ground Tour in October. It was a lovely sunny day. Started from Page airport, which is very small, easy to find, and very informal. There was only the two of us, and a nice old chap for the pilot, in a Cesna. All very informative and professional. Took us to see the sights - Lake Powell, Navaho Mountain, Horseshoe Bend, Rainbow Bridge. Flight took about 45 minutes. When we landed at Monument Valley we were met by our Navaho Guide and his 4X4 (no waiting around). Again there was only the two of us, which was fortunate, because it was a bit cool outside and normally everyone would be in open seats on the back, but because there wa only the two of us, we asked to sit in with the guide, which was worth it because he was able to talk to us, keep us informed, and answer our questions about the Navaho culture. The Monument Valley wasbeautiful as expected - took lots of photos. Then back to the plane and back to Page. The pilot was very accommodating, and agreed to take a shorter route back to ease my wife's air sickness. We were doing a driving tour from Garnd Canyon, to Lake Powell, to Bryce, then Zion and Vegas, so this was a good way to take in Monument Valley without a long and uninteresting drive.

In August 2024, we booked the Southside Explorer with a glacier landing for my family of 4.  Unfortunately, the morning of our tour it was rainy with low clouds.  Talkeetna Air Taxi was extremely communicative with us that morning and offered us a variety of options for rebooking.  We chose to fly that evening based on their recommendation and it did not disappoint!  

My 13 year old son loves all things flying and our pilot, Tim, let him sit up front with him on the way to Denali.  It was a dream come true for him.  The entire flight was smooth and the pilot was full of information both on the way to the glacier and coming back.  It was clear he loved his job!  He told facts about the park as well as interesting historical facts.  

This is really the best way to see both Denali the mountain as well as the park.  We couldn't recommend this tour enough.  The company was fantastic to deal with and the actual flight was wonderful!

review_title: Amazing "Bucket List" flight and landing on Ruth Glacier
review_text: My wife and I checked off a "bucket list" item by flying with pilot Andy Young and Talkeetna Air Taxi and landing on Ruth Glacier in Denali National Park.  Although the day was overcast and prevented us from seeing the summit of Mount Denali, we were able to land on Ruth Glacier.  The snow was pristine as we were the first flight to land on the snow that fell the night below.  Andy flew the de Havilland DHC-3 Otter with great skill, banking both ways to permit all passengers to get stunning views of the glacier and surrounding mountains.  It was an experience we will never forget.  I encourage everyone who travels to Alaska to make this a MUST DO activity!  You will not regret it!

Eric, my son, Tina his wife, and I were happy that we had added a Talkeetna Air Taxi flight that included a glacier landing to our itinerary. That flight was awesome to Mt. Denali, the tallest mountain in North America. I felt as though we had landed one level shy of Heaven -- total silence, pure white snow with diamond crystals, the bluest of skies, white fluffy clouds. The only words I could utter were "Thank You, God".
Was in Talkeetna on the fourth of July, took the flight onto the glacier.  The entire experience was absolutely wonderful.  Fully recommend to everyone!

I was extremely lucky due to the excellent weather and visibility.  Although the plane could not land, the pilot was extremely cooperative and showed us a great time on air.  We made rounds so each side of the plane could enjoy all the great views. Everywhere I looked was a picture perfect frame.
This was our favorite experience, hands down!  Seeing the mountains that close was extraordinary and beautiful. A profound experience!

review_title: Alaska is amazing to see from the air!
review_text:
Leighan, our pilot, was awesome.  She's from Fairbanks and has a lot of knowledge about the area and wildlife.   The views were fantastic.  I've posted some pictures but they don't do justice to the real views.   We've gone on multiple trips in the summer with Talkeetna Air, including glacier landings which were equally awesome but our destination to an Iditarod Checkpoint during the race was something we'll never forget.  Talkeetna Air didn't an outstanding job from the 1st time we came to south central Alaska and we've loved every trip.   

We booked the tour in advance so we showed up 30 minutes early as requested and we were quickly checked in.  You have to be weighed with everything you're taking with you but no one sees the weight except the person behind the counter.   Once everyone was ready we were taken out to an Otter plane and could pick out the seats we wanted.  I asked if I could sit in the copilot's seat (because we'd done this before) and got an awesome view!   It was about an hour to the Rainy Pass checkpoint but Leighan told us all kinds of interesting facts about the Alaskan range, the various mountains, rivers and wildlife.   She found the Iditarod trail and from about 2000' feet followed it and pointed out teams as we went by.  It was really cool.   It got better after we landed in Rainy Pass.  If you're interested in seeing how the Iditarod really works this is absolutely the best thing you can do outside of volunteering and being part of the race yourself.  Leighan was helpful in where to go and had us check in at 12:30 to make sure everyone was OK.  Seeing the teams come into the Rainy Pass, check in, take care of their dogs, talk to the vets and answer our questions was unbelievably nice.  The only thing that could have made the excursion better is if we could have stayed longer.  I highly recommend this trip (and the glacier landing tours)!

From my initial contact by phone to the perfect smooth landing back at the Talkteena airstrip, everyone was super nice and competent.  Matt, our pilot did a wonderful job flying and pointing out interesting points on our tour.  The landing on Ruth Glacier was incredible. Would highly recommend TAT and would advise everyone to take a flight seeing tour if at all possible.

review_title: Glacier Landing! Engaged on Mt. Denali!
review_text: Yes! (For more than just one reason!) My boyfriend and I were planning our trip to Alaska and this came up as one of the top rated attractions - for good reason. We knew we wanted to do the plane tour but the glacier landing was one we were debating on. Although it's not that much more money, Alaska is already expensive and we didn't know that it would be worth it. Well, it was! Little did I know that my boyfriend had called TAT ahead of time to mention that he was going to propose on the glacier. Upon arrival, I had no idea! The entire crew knew and treated us just like everyone else, which was kind and helpful. The takeoff and plane tour itself was great. There was never a concern for safety. The pilot kept us informed throughout the trip on where we were flying over and facts about the mountain. Landing on the glacier was really cool, as was walking around in a couple of feet of snow on the most quiet and serene place I've ever been. Nothing compares. The pilot took a

I was being dropped off at Denali base camp as I was trying to climb Denali. Upon being dropped off and after the plane left I realized that 5 of my buckles were broken on my pack during the transportation. One of them being the hip belt which is the most important. I emailed Talkeetna Air and all they said was...well sorry... we will pass it on. This is a humongous deal for an expedition. I will let all of my climbing friends and community know about this experience. There are plenty of other taxi services in Talkeetna. I would highly recommend a more mom and pop one vs. Talkeetna's commercial feel.

Would highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi!!  They were super accommodating due to weather!  They  originally bumped our reservation due to poor weather (safety conditions) and we were given the option for rescheduling or getting a full refund.  Luckily my friend and I had flexibility so we rescheduled for a few days later and had an amazing time.  Seemed like they flew us around more than what we were suppose to see as well.  Love every minute!!

We did the Scenic Flight with Glacier Landing however due to the weather we were unable to do the Glacier Landing which was absolutely devastating.
we did still manage to do the scenic flight which was lovely and the scenery over the mountains was just beautiful however we were really upset we didnt get to land. 
I think i was a little more annoyed as the pilot just announced to us in such a casual manner "yeah so it doesn't look like we'll be landing today sorry folks" so blaze. 
There was no heartfelt emotion behind that which really annoyed me. He gets to do this trip every single day where as for the people on board this is a once in a lifetime opportunity. 
We were offerred a partial refund for not getting to land on the glacier which was very appreciated. We were just very disappointed. However the views from the plane were amazing and if you do get to land then you should feel very lucky! 
The flight before and after ours both managed to land on the glacier.
Outstanding trip - weather was great.  Pilot did an excellent job of providing views from every angle for every passenger - fantastic landing on the glacier.  Excellent trip.  Would recommend highly.

@ 12 seater designed to soar through the clouds to try and glimpse Denali's peak, which is rare. But the other peaks, glaciers and runoffs are well worth it. Each seat has a window and the pilot provides commentary and answers questions that are hard t pose as the mikes on the headsets don't work. Well worth it and the flight was even and calm, important for queasy fliers.

This was the highlight of our Alaska trip -- we lucked out and got a nice sunny day for our flight. The view of the mountains were gorgeous and the plane captain provided humorous and knowledgeable commentary throughout the trip. Definitely a must-do for anyone passing through the area.
This was an experience to remember! Great ground crew, a wonderful pilot and guide, and a memorable flight! Thanks to you all.

review_title: Best flight experience you can get!
review_text: We took the 830am grand Denali trip. It lasted till about 11:00am. We went around the mountain and did the glacier landing. I definitely recommend the glacier landing and it should be on your bucket list for sure! Our pilot Dave was informative and he let me be co pilot on our way out which gave me the best view possible! Would recommend this if you are visiting the park as no view beats the aerial view!

review_title: Highlight of our 16 day Alaska trip!
review_text: We booked with Talkeetna Air Taxi based on the recommendation of our tour agent Colette of Rainbow Mountain Adventures and we were amazed.  This experience was not only the highlight of our trip, it was one of my greatest experiences of all time!  We were on the last flight of the day and the weather had been iffy.  Most of the flights were not able to land on the glacier that day and we almost rebooked for the next morning.  The wonderful staffed talked us in to taking the flight and WOW, what an experience!  The flight up to and around Denali was awe-inspiring, we saw all of the glaciers and Chris, our pilot, pointed out the trail that the climbers use and much more.  I assumed we would have to return to the airport, but instead we landed on Thunder glacier, miles of virgin snow, not one track or footprint.  As we all stood and absorbed the gorgeous sights and listened to the glaciers sounding in the distance, all was right with the world!  Everyone on board including Chris was ecstatic!  This very professional company goes out of their way to satisfy customers while still being safe.  As anyone who has traveled around Alaska knows (and we quickly learned) you can always predict that the weather will be unpredictable.  If you ever get a chance take this once in a lifetime flight, it is a must do!

Oh my gosh!  Highlight of our trip.  We did the McKinley base camp flight and it was breathtaking, inspirational, beautiful flight.  We kep going back and forth over whether we should pay the extra for the glacier landing.  SO GLAD WE DID!  Best part of the flight! Landed at a location with magnificent views of McKinley.  We lucked out and had a beautiful, clear day.  Couldn't have been better!

Called on June 1st , which was a sunny day.  My husband and I decided we wanted to wait until the next day to make this trip as our camera battery was dead, I was talking to Annie and she said not to wait as the weather changes and tomorrow might not be as nice.  When I explained to her that we did not want to go because our camera was dead, she offered us a camera to use.  Well we went and what a wonderful time we had.  When we arrived in their office after being picked up we were greeted by Beverly, who was delightful, very knowledgeable and helpful.  Trent was our pilot who was great also excellent at pointing out different things on our flight as well as a photographer once we arrived on the glacier.  After we returned Beverly drve us to town.  My thanks to Annie, Trent and Beverly for making this a very special trip.  I would highly recommend using Talkeetna Air Taxi.

review_title: Definitely worth the money - just do it!
review_text:
My friend and I did the "Grand Denali" tour yesterday at 2pm.  As expected, it was an amazing tour. The weather cooperated also -it was a beautiful, sunny day. Our pilot, Richard, was a wonderful tour guide. We stopped on Ruth Glacier for about 15 mins. There were some campers/hikers settled in there. Knowing that we would fly out - not climb, was a very good feeling. The tour was 2 hours which was a perfect amount of time. We were starting to get a little cold. 
We looked at K2 Aviation as well - it looks like they also have a good set-up. We received a little bit of a discount from the lodge where we were staying (Denali Overlook - outstanding). All the prices were pretty comparable - not cheap, but once in a lifetime event.

review_title: the feeling of breath with the Mt McKinley
review_text: we booked for Aug 19 but cancelled for weather but we were lucky to get it on Aug 21. It was so amazing we were so close to Mt Mckinley. Richard, our captain, was very professional and brought us different angles to see the mountain. And the glacier landing, the pure snow and calm atmasphere while Mt McKinley was there with sunlight on it. 2 children were very excited. Air Taxi really gave us one of the best memories in Alaska.

We took the Grand Denali flight with glacier landing.  The entire staff in the office was friendly and helpful.  I was nervous, having never flown in such a small plane.  A nice lady behind the desk reassured me and eased my fears.  We flew in a 5 seater plane, and Tim was our pilot.  Like the people in the office, Tim was professional, informative, and friendly.  He helped us into our seats, made sure we were buckled properly, and had our headsets working.  I couldn't believe the flight was so smooth!  Tim was an excellent pilot and tour guide - he answered all of our questions, and maneuvered the plane so that everyone could see everything out of their own window.  The views were stunning!  We had a sunny day, with a few clouds near Denali, but could clearly see the mountain and surrounding areas.  I took well over 100 pictures.  We landed on Ruth Glacier.  If you are able to add a glacier landing to your flight, do it!  Walking on a glacier and seeing the mountains towering over us was just incredible!  Bring sunglasses though, since there is glare from the snow.  Flying with TAT was the highlight of my Alaska vacation, and if I ever make it back, I will definitely fly with them again.

review_title: All I can say is WOW!
review_text:
Heidi, the young lady who booked our reservation was incredibly helpful and informative. She was honest and forthcoming. When we arrived, the location was close to the town center of Talkeetna. A great little place to visit. Ate at Mexican Moose and Payos's Thai. Both are thumbs up. Anyway, waited in a comfortable area with their cat, Beaver they gave us glacier boots so our shoes would stay dry and about 10 minutes after checking our pilot, Tyler, called us up and we were ready! He gave us a briefing and off we went!  The views were spectacular. Close up views of Denali, Hunter and Moose's tooth. Landed on a glacier which was surreal. We were able to see Ruth glacier. It was awesome! The weather was perfect, blue skies, 75 degrees and bright! Didn't need a jacket but take sunglasses! The plane was comfortable and roomy. 

Would do it again. Loved Tyler! Best pilot ever!

review_title: Over the top from Down Under-AWESOME
review_text:
We went on the Base camp flight 2nd of June 2012, our pilot was Tyler. Firstly to you Tyler....AWESOME Mate never felt so safe in a small plane before, your expierience was evident and your knowledge and commentary was great, right from the safety briefing and offer to ride up front as (Co-Pilot) with yourself. The plane felt extremely well maintained and solid. From the time we arrived ALL of you guy's were very welcoming and friendly and nothing seemed to much trouble, your counter staff we met on arrival took the time to show us a map of were we would fly, told us of features we should keep an eye out for and so MUCH more. In reccommending TAT to all who may venture into your beautiful little town all we can say is that your people are as spectacular as the views we were so lucky to share the Glacier landing will be with us always and we can't wait to share our photos and video with the Family back in Austalia !!!!!

Again thanks and much gratitude from two very impressed Aussie's
Steve & Lynda
Sydney, Australia

We did the Base Camp McKinley tour with a landing on Eldridge Glacier on 8/16/11, and it was incredible! It was the highlight of our trip, and a highlight of a lifetime. The day we went it was extremely clear, so the views were breathtaking! My wife and I both agreed that because the power and the beauty were so intense, there were times when it was very emotional and even spiritual.

Was it expensive? Yes. Was it worth it? Absolutely! It was worth every penny! We found a discount coupon in the Bear Foot magazine that helped, but even without it, it would have been worth it. Also, if you decide to do this, I hope you get Bill (forgot to get his last name) as your pilot. He was a wealth of knowledge, and his commentary added so much to the experience.  

Friends look at our pictures and are amazed (as we were)! I know I sound like a commercial, but this was a fantastic experience in a place loaded with fantastic experiences. I strongly recommend it and Talkeetna Air Taxi; they were great!
